title.raw: 卷三十七 志第十三 曆七 Volume 37 Treatises 13: Calendar 7

sentences.zh: 志第十三 歷七

translations.literal: Treatise Thirteen, Calendar Seven.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Thirteen: Calendrics, Part Seven.

sentences.zh: ▲回回曆法一

translations.literal: ▲ Huihui Calendar Method One.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ The Islamic (Huihui) Calendar Method, Part One

sentences.zh: 《回回曆法》，西域默狄納國王馬哈麻所作。

translations.literal: The Huihui Calendar Method, composed by Mahama, king of Medina in the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: The Islamic Calendar Treatise was composed by Muhammad, king of Medina in the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 其地北極高二十四度半，經度偏西一百零七度，約在雲南之西八千餘昊。

translations.literal: That land's north polar height is twenty-four and a half degrees; longitude slants west one hundred seven degrees, approximately more than eight thousand hao west of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 24.5°; longitude lies 107° west [of the Chinese standard], roughly 8,000+ li west of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 其曆元用隋開皇己未，即其建國之年也。

translations.literal: Its calendar origin uses Sui Kaihuang jiwei, namely the year of its state-founding.
translations.idiomatic: Its epoch is Sui Kaihuang jiwei (599 CE)—the year of the kingdom's founding.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，得其書於元都。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, obtained its book at the Yuan capital.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Hongwu era the treatise was recovered at the Yuan capital (Dadu).

sentences.zh: 十五年秋，太祖謂西域推測天象最精，其五星緯度又中國所無。

translations.literal: Autumn of the fifteenth year, the Founder said the Western Regions' reckoning of celestial phenomena is most precise; their five stars' latitudes moreover are what China lacks.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of Hongwu 15 the Founder observed that Western astronomical prediction is unrivaled in precision, and that planetary latitudes in their system were unknown in Chinese astronomy.

sentences.zh: 命翰林李翀、吳伯宗同回回大師馬沙亦黑等譯其書。

translations.literal: Ordered Hanlin Li Chong and Wu Bozong together with Huihui great master Ma Sha Yih Hei and others to translate its book.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Hanlin academicians Li Chong and Wu Bozong, together with the Muslim astronomer Jamal al-Din (Ma Sha Yih Hei) and others, to translate the work.

sentences.zh: 其法不用閏月，以三百六十五日爲一歲。

translations.literal: Its method does not use intercalary months; takes three hundred sixty-five days as one year.
translations.idiomatic: The system has no intercalary months; the solar year is fixed at 365 days.

sentences.zh: 歲十二宮，宮有閏日，凡百二十八年而宮閏三十一日。

translations.literal: The year has twelve palaces; palaces have intercalary days; in all one hundred twenty-eight years, then palace intercalates thirty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: The year comprises twelve zodiac signs; signs receive leap days—31 leap days in every 128-year cycle.

sentences.zh: 以三百五十四日爲一週，週一十十月有閏日。

translations.literal: Takes three hundred fifty-four days as one cycle; cycle one-ten-ten months have intercalary day.
translations.idiomatic: The lunar cycle is 354 days; each twelve-month cycle admits intercalary days in its months.

sentences.zh: 凡有閏閏凡百二十八年而而宮閏三十一日，以三百五十四日爲一週，周十二月，月有閏日。

translations.literal: In all there is intercalary intercalary; in all one hundred twenty-eight years then then palace intercalates thirty-one days, takes three hundred fifty-four days as one cycle, cycle twelve months, months have intercalary day.
translations.idiomatic: Over 128 years the solar cycle gains 31 leap days; the lunar cycle is 354 days in twelve months, with intercalary days inserted in the months.

sentences.zh: 凡三十年月閏十一日，歷千九百四十一年，宮月日辰再會。

translations.literal: In all thirty years months intercalate eleven days; spanning one thousand nine hundred forty-one years, palace-month-day-time stars again meet.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven intercalary days are added to the months every 30 years; after 1,941 years the solar sign, lunar month, day, and hour realign.

sentences.zh: 此其立法之大概也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of its establishing law.
translations.idiomatic: Such are the broad principles of the system's design.

sentences.zh: 按西域歷術見於史者，在唐有《九執曆》，元有札馬魯丁之《萬年曆》。

translations.literal: Examining Western Regions calendrical arts seen in histories: in Tang there was the Nine Offices Calendar; in Yuan, Jamal al-Din's Ten-Thousand-Year Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Western calendrical systems recorded in history include the Tang Nine Offices Calendar and Jamal al-Din's Eternal Calendar of the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 《九執因》最疏，《萬年曆》行之未久。

translations.literal: The Nine Offices Cause is coarsest; the Ten-Thousand-Year Calendar was practiced not long.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Offices Calendar was the crudest; the Eternal Calendar was employed only briefly.

sentences.zh: 唯《回回曆》設科，隸欽天監，與《大統》參用二百七十餘年。

translations.literal: Only the Huihui Calendar established a section, subordinate to the Imperial Astronomy Directorate, with the Grand Concordance jointly used two hundred seventy-odd years.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Islamic calendar was instituted as a formal curriculum at the Imperial Observatory and used alongside the Datong calendar for more than 270 years.

sentences.zh: 雖於交食之有無深淺，時有出入，然勝於《九執》、《萬年》遠矣。

translations.literal: Though on eclipses' having-or-not and depth-shallow at times there was divergence, yet it surpassed the Nine Offices and Ten-Thousand-Year far.
translations.idiomatic: Predictions of eclipse magnitude and visibility still varied at times, but the system far surpassed the Nine Offices and Eternal calendars.

sentences.zh: 但其書多脫誤。

translations.literal: But its book has many omissions and errors.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the transmitted text is full of lacunae and errors.

sentences.zh: 盜蓋其人之隸籍臺官者，類以土盤布算，仍用其本國之書。

translations.literal: Thieves—presumably its people enrolled on the observatory roster—mostly used earth-plate spread calculation and still used their homeland's books.
translations.idiomatic: Presumably because observatory staff of that tradition relied on sand-board calculation and continued to use texts in their native script.

sentences.zh: 而明之習其術者，如唐順之、陳壤、袁黃輩之所論著又自成一家言。

translations.literal: Yet Ming scholars of its art, such as Tang Shunzhi, Chen Rang, Yuan Huang, and their company's discussed writings again formed one family's speech.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Ming scholars of the tradition—Tang Shunzhi, Chen Rang, Yuan Huang, and others—produced treatises advancing independent interpretations.

sentences.zh: 以故 翻譯之本不行於世，其殘缺宜也。

translations.literal: By this cause the translated edition did not circulate in the age; its fragments and omissions are fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the translated edition never gained currency; its incompleteness is understandable.

sentences.zh: 今爲博訪專門之裔，考究其原書，以補其脫落，正其訛舛，爲《回回曆尖》，著於篇。

translations.literal: Now, to seek broadly specialist descendants, examine and investigate its original book, to supplement its shedding and falling, correct its errors, make the Huihui Calendar Point, and write it in this section.
translations.idiomatic: We have now sought out specialists in the tradition, collated the original sources, filled lacunae and corrected errors, and set down the Islamic Calendar Method in this chapter.

sentences.zh: 積年 起西域阿喇必年，隋開皇己未。

translations.literal: Accumulated years: from Western Regions Ala-must year, Sui Kaihuang jiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated years: from the Western Hijra era through Sui Kaihuang jiwei.

sentences.zh: 下至洪武甲子，七百八十六年。

translations.literal: Down to Hongwu jiazi, seven hundred eighty-six years.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Hongwu jiazi (1384 CE)—786 years in total.

sentences.zh: 用數 天周度三百六十。

translations.literal: Used numbers: heaven circuit degrees three hundred sixty.
translations.idiomatic: Constants: celestial revolution = 360°.

sentences.zh: 每度六十分，每分六十秒，微纖以下俱准此。

translations.literal: Each degree sixty fen; each fen sixty miao; micro and fiber below all follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Each degree = 60 minutes; each minute = 60 seconds; smaller units follow the same ratio.

sentences.zh: 宮十二。

translations.literal: Palaces twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve zodiac signs.

sentences.zh: 每宮三十度。

translations.literal: Each palace thirty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Each sign spans 30°.

sentences.zh: 目周分一千四百四十，時二十四，每時六十分。

translations.literal: Eye circuit fen one thousand four hundred forty; hours twenty-four; each hour sixty fen.
translations.idiomatic: Diurnal arc = 1,440 parts; 24 hours per day, 60 parts per hour.

sentences.zh: 刻九十六。

translations.literal: Ke ninety-six.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-six quarter-hours (ke) per day.

sentences.zh: 每刻十五分。

translations.literal: Each ke fifteen fen.
translations.idiomatic: Each quarter-hour = 15 parts.

sentences.zh: 宮度起白羊，節氣首春分，命時起午正。

translations.literal: Palace degrees start at Aries; qi nodes head at spring equinox; ordained hours start at noon proper.
translations.idiomatic: Sign degrees begin at Aries; solar terms begin at the vernal equinox; clock hours begin at true noon.

sentences.zh: 午初四刻屬前日。

translations.literal: Noon initial four ke belong to the prior day.
translations.idiomatic: The first four ke after noon belong to the previous civil day.

sentences.zh: 七曜數 日一，月二，火三，水四，木五，金六，土七。

translations.literal: Seven luminaries numbers: Sun one, Moon two, Mars three, Mercury four, Jupiter five, Venus six, Saturn seven.
translations.idiomatic: Seven luminaries numbering: Sun 1, Moon 2, Mars 3, Mercury 4, Jupiter 5, Venus 6, Saturn 7.

sentences.zh: 以七曜紀不用甲子。

translations.literal: Records by seven luminaries; does not use jiazi.
translations.idiomatic: Dates are reckoned by the seven-day planetary week, not the sexagenary cycle.

sentences.zh: 宮數 白羊初，金牛一，陰陽二，世蟹三，獅子四，變女五，天秤六，天蠍七，人馬八，磨羯九，實寶瓶十，變魚十一。

translations.literal: Palace numbers: Aries initial, Taurus one, Yin-Yang two, World Crab three, Lion four, Change Maiden five, Libra six, Sky Scorpion seven, Human Horse eight, Mójié nine, Solid Treasure Bottle ten, Change Fish eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Sign indices: Aries 0, Taurus 1, Gemini 2, Cancer 3, Leo 4, Virgo 5, Libra 6, Scorpio 7, Sagittarius 8, Capricorn 9, Aquarius 10, Pisces 11.

sentences.zh: 宮日 白羊戌宮三十一日。

translations.literal: Palace days: Aries xu palace thirty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: Sign days—Aries (xu palace): 31 days.

sentences.zh: 金牛酉宮三十一日。

translations.literal: Taurus you palace thirty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: Taurus (you palace): 31 days.

sentences.zh: 陰陽申宮三十一日。

translations.literal: Yin-Yang shen palace thirty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: Gemini (shen palace): 31 days.

sentences.zh: 巨蟹未宮三十二日。

translations.literal: Giant Crab wei palace thirty-two days.
translations.idiomatic: Cancer (wei palace): 32 days.

sentences.zh: 獅子午宮三十一日。

translations.literal: Lion zi-wu palace thirty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: Leo (zi/wu palace): 31 days.

sentences.zh: 孌女巳宮三十一日。

translations.literal: Twin Maiden si palace thirty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: Virgo (si palace): 31 days.

sentences.zh: 天秤辰宮三十一日。

translations.literal: Libra chen palace thirty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: Libra (chen palace): 31 days.

sentences.zh: 天蠍卯宮三十日。

translations.literal: Sky Scorpion mao palace thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: Scorpio (mao palace): 30 days.

sentences.zh: 人馬寅宮二十九日。

translations.literal: Human Horse yin palace twenty-nine days.
translations.idiomatic: Sagittarius (yin palace): 29 days.

sentences.zh: 磨羯醜宮二十九日。

translations.literal: Mójié chou palace twenty-nine days.
translations.idiomatic: Capricorn (chou palace): 29 days.

sentences.zh: 寶瓶子宮三十日。

translations.literal: Treasure Bottle zi palace thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: Aquarius (zi palace): 30 days.

sentences.zh: 變魚亥宮三十日。

translations.literal: Change Fish hai palace thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: Pisces (hai palace): 30 days.

sentences.zh: 已上十二宮，所謂不動之月，凡三百六十五日，乃歲周之日也。

translations.literal: The twelve palaces above are the so-called unmoving months; in all three hundred sixty-five days—the days of the year circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve signs above constitute the "fixed months" of the solar year, totaling 365 days—the days of the annual circuit.

sentences.zh: 若遇宮分有閏之年，於變魚宮加一日，凡三百六十六日。

translations.literal: If one meets a year when palace division has intercalary days, add one day in the Change Fish palace; in all three hundred sixty-six days.
translations.idiomatic: In a year with a solar leap day, one day is added in Pisces, for 366 days total.

sentences.zh: 月分大小 單月大，變月小。

translations.literal: Month division large and small: single months large, change months small.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar month lengths: odd months long, even months short.

sentences.zh: 凡十二月，所謂動之月也。

translations.literal: In all twelve months—the so-called moving months.
translations.idiomatic: These twelve constitute the "moving months" of the lunar year.

sentences.zh: 月大三十日，月小二十九日，凡三百五十四日，乃十二月之日也。

translations.literal: Large months thirty days, small months twenty-nine days; in all three hundred fifty-four days—the days of twelve months.
translations.idiomatic: Long months have 30 days and short months 29, totaling 354 days for the twelve lunar months.

sentences.zh: 遇月分有閏之處，於第十二月內增一日，凡三百五十五日。

translations.literal: Where month division has intercalary days, increase one day within the twelfth month; in all three hundred fifty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: When a lunar leap day is required, one day is added within the twelfth month, yielding 355 days.

sentences.zh: 太陽五星最高行度隋己未測定。

translations.literal: Sun and five stars greatest-high motion degrees, measured and fixed at Sui jiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Solar and planetary apogee longitudes, fixed by observation in Sui jiwei (599 CE).

sentences.zh: 太陽二宮二十九度二十一分。

translations.literal: Sun: two palaces twenty-nine degrees twenty-one fen.
translations.idiomatic: Sun: sign 2, 29°21′.

sentences.zh: 土星八宮十四度四十八分。

translations.literal: Saturn: eight palaces fourteen degrees forty-eight fen.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn: sign 8, 14°48′.

sentences.zh: 木星六宮初度八分。

translations.literal: Jupiter: six palaces initial degree eight fen.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter: sign 6, 0°08′.

sentences.zh: 火星四宮十五度四分。

translations.literal: Mars: four palaces fifteen degrees four fen.
translations.idiomatic: Mars: sign 4, 15°04′.

sentences.zh: 金星二宮十七度六分。

translations.literal: Venus: two palaces seventeen degrees six fen.
translations.idiomatic: Venus: sign 2, 17°06′.

sentences.zh: 水星七宮六度十七分。

translations.literal: Mercury: seven palaces six degrees seventeen fen.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury: sign 7, 6°17′.

sentences.zh: 求宮分閏日無之餘日。

translations.literal: Seek palace-division intercalary day and the remainder days without it.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to determine whether the year has a solar leap day, and the weekday of the first day if there is none.

sentences.zh: 置西域歲前積年，減一，以一百五十九乘之，一百二十八年內，閏三十一日故以總數乘。

translations.literal: Set the accumulated years before the Western year, subtract one, multiply by one hundred fifty-nine; within one hundred twenty-eight years thirty-one days are intercalated, hence multiply by the total number.
translations.idiomatic: Set the accumulated years before the current Western year, subtract 1, and multiply by 159 (the total leap days per 128-year solar cycle).

sentences.zh: 內加一十五，閏應。

translations.literal: Add fifteen inside; intercalary correspond.
translations.idiomatic: Add 15 inside for the intercalary adjustment.

sentences.zh: 以一百二十八屢減之，餘不滿之數，若在九十七已上，閏限。

translations.literal: Repeatedly subtract one hundred twenty-eight; of the remainder not full, if at ninety-seven and above, intercalary limit.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly subtract 128; if the remainder is 97 or greater, there is a solar leap day that year.

sentences.zh: 其年宮分有閏日，已下無閏日。

translations.literal: That year palace division has an intercalary day; below that, no intercalary day.
translations.idiomatic: If so, the year has a solar leap day; otherwise it does not.

sentences.zh: 於除得之數內加五，宮分立成起火三，故須加五。

translations.literal: Within the number obtained by division add five; palace-division stand-complete tables rise from fire three, hence must add five.
translations.idiomatic: To the quotient add 5—the sign tables begin with Mars (no. 3), hence the increment.

sentences.zh: 滿七去之，餘即所求年白羊宮一日七曜。

translations.literal: When full of seven remove it; the remainder is the seven luminaries of the first day of Aries for the sought year.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out complete sevens; the remainder is the weekday of the first day of Aries for the sought year.

sentences.zh: 有閏加一日，後同。

translations.literal: If there is intercalary, add one day; later the same.
translations.idiomatic: If there is a leap day, add one day; subsequent procedures are the same.

sentences.zh: 求月分閏日朔之餘日。

translations.literal: Seek month-division intercalary day and the remainder days of the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find lunar leap days and the weekday of the first day of the first month.

sentences.zh: 置西域歲前積年，減一，以一百三十一年乘之，總數乘。

translations.literal: Set the accumulated years before the Western year, subtract one, multiply by one hundred thirty-one; multiply by the total number.
translations.idiomatic: Set the accumulated years before the current Western year, subtract 1, and multiply by 131.

sentences.zh: 內加一百九十四，閏應。

translations.literal: Add one hundred ninety-four inside; intercalary correspond.
translations.idiomatic: Add 194 inside for the intercalary adjustment.

sentences.zh: 以三十爲法屢減之，餘在十九已上，閏限。

translations.literal: Repeatedly subtract using thirty as divisor; if the remainder is at nineteen and above, intercalary limit.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly subtract 30; if the remainder is 19 or greater, there is a lunar leap day that year.

sentences.zh: 其年月分有閏閏已下則無。

translations.literal: That year month division has intercalary intercalary; below that, none.
translations.idiomatic: If so, the year has a lunar leap day; otherwise it does not.

sentences.zh: 於除得之數，滿七去之，餘即所求年第一月一日七曜。

translations.literal: On the number obtained by division, when full of seven remove it; the remainder is the seven luminaries of the first day of the first month for the sought year.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out complete sevens from the quotient; the remainder is the weekday of the first day of the first month.

sentences.zh: 加次法 置積日，全積並宮閏所得數。

translations.literal: Increment method: Set accumulated days, the full accumulation together with the number obtained from palace intercalary.
translations.idiomatic: Epoch correction: set accumulated days, combining the full accumulation with the solar leap-day count.

sentences.zh: 減月閏內加三百三十一日，己未春正前日。

translations.literal: Subtract month intercalary; within add three hundred thirty-one days—the day before jiwei spring first.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the lunar leap count; add 331 days inside (the day before jiwei spring first).

sentences.zh: 以三百五十四一年數除之，餘數內減去所加三百三十一，又減二十三，足成一年日數。

translations.literal: Divide by three hundred fifty-four one-year count; within the remainder subtract the three hundred thirty-one added, again subtract twenty-three, sufficient to complete one year's day count.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 354; from the remainder subtract the 331 added, then subtract 23 to complete one year's day count.

sentences.zh: 又減二十四，洪武甲子加次。

translations.literal: Again subtract twenty-four—the Hongwu jiazi increment.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 24 again for the Hongwu jiazi epoch correction.

sentences.zh: 又減一，改應所損之一日。

translations.literal: Again subtract one—the revision correspond loses one day.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 1 again for the one-day revision adjustment.

sentences.zh: 爲實距年己未至今得數。

translations.literal: This is the actual distance from jiwei year to the present, the number obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the true interval in days from the jiwei epoch to the present.

sentences.zh: 又法：以氣積宮閏並通閏爲氣積內減月閏，置十一，以距年乘之，外加十四，以三十除之，得月閏數。

translations.literal: Alternate method: Take qi accumulated with palace intercalary and together as qi accumulated; within subtract month intercalary; set eleven; multiply by distance years; outside add fourteen; divide by thirty to obtain month intercalary number.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate method: combine solar leap accumulation with general intercalation as the solar total; subtract lunar leap; set 11, multiply by years from epoch, add 14 outside, divide by 30 to obtain the lunar leap count.

sentences.zh: 以三百五十四除之，餘減洪武加次二十四，又減補日二十三，又減改應損日一，得數如前。

translations.literal: Divide by three hundred fifty-four; from the remainder subtract Hongwu increment twenty-four, again subtract supplement day twenty-three, again subtract revision lost day one—the number obtained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 354; from the remainder subtract the Hongwu correction (24), the supplement day (23), and the revision day (1)—as before.

sentences.zh: 求通閏，置十一日，以距年乘之。

translations.literal: Seek general intercalary: set eleven days; multiply by distance years.
translations.idiomatic: To find general intercalation: set 11 days and multiply by years from epoch.

sentences.zh: 求宮閏前見。

translations.literal: Seek palace intercalary: see above.
translations.idiomatic: For solar leap days, see the procedure above.

sentences.zh: ▲太陽行度

translations.literal: ▲ Sun motion in degrees.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Solar Motion in Degrees

sentences.zh: 求最高總度 置西域歲前積年，入總年零年月分日期立成內，各取前年前月前日最高行度並之。

translations.literal: Seek greatest-high total degrees: Set accumulated years before the Western year; enter the stand-complete of total years with zero year-month-day; for each take the prior year, prior month, prior day greatest-high motion degrees and combine them.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for total apogee longitude: set accumulated years before the current Western year; enter the lookup table for whole years with zero month and day; for each component take the prior year, prior month, and prior day apogee longitudes and sum them.

sentences.zh: 如求十年，則取九年之類。

translations.literal: If seeking ten years, then take nine years' category.
translations.idiomatic: To find year 10, take the entry for year 9, and so on.

sentences.zh: 蓋立成中行度，俱本年本月日足數也。

translations.literal: For stand-complete motion degrees are all this year this month this day full numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Table entries give complete values for the current year, month, and day.

sentences.zh: 如十年竟求十年，則逾數矣。

translations.literal: If at ten years end one seeks ten years, then exceeds the number.
translations.idiomatic: Using the year-10 entry when computing through year 10 would overshoot.

sentences.zh: 月日義同。

translations.literal: Month and day: principle the same.
translations.idiomatic: The same rule applies to months and days.

sentences.zh: 後仿此。

translations.literal: Later imitate this.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequent procedures follow this pattern.

sentences.zh: 求最高行度 置求到最高總度，加測定太陽最高行度，二宮二十九度二十一分。

translations.literal: Seek greatest-high motion degrees: Set the greatest-high total degrees obtained; add the measured-fixed Sun greatest-high motion degrees—two palaces twenty-nine degrees twenty-one fen.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for apogee longitude: set the total apogee longitude obtained and add the fixed solar apogee at epoch—sign 2, 29°21′.

sentences.zh: 即年求年白羊宮最高行度。

translations.literal: That is the greatest-high motion degrees of Aries palace for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: This is the solar apogee longitude in Aries for the sought year.

sentences.zh: 如求次宮，累加五秒零六微。

translations.literal: If seeking the next palace, cumulatively add five miao zero six micro.
translations.idiomatic: For the next sign, add 5′06″ cumulatively.

sentences.zh: 求次月，加四秒五十六微。

translations.literal: If seeking the next month, add four miao fifty-six micro.
translations.idiomatic: For the next month, add 4′56″.

sentences.zh: 求中心行度日平行度。

translations.literal: Seek center motion degrees day parallel degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for mean longitude and daily mean motion.

sentences.zh: 置積年入總年零年月日立成內，各取日中心行度並之，取法同前。

translations.literal: Set accumulated years; enter the stand-complete of total years with zero year-month-day; for each take day center motion degrees and combine them—the taking method same as before.
translations.idiomatic: Set accumulated years; enter the lookup table for whole years with zero month and day; take each day's mean longitude and sum them—same retrieval method as above.

sentences.zh: 內減一分四秒，即所求白羊宮第一日中心行度。

translations.literal: Within subtract one fen four miao; that is the center motion degrees of Aries palace first day sought.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 1′04″ inside; this is the mean longitude for the first day of Aries in the sought year.

sentences.zh: 求各宮月日，按每日行度五十九分八秒累加之。

translations.literal: To seek each sign's month-days: by each day's travel of 59 parts 8 seconds accumulate and add.
translations.idiomatic: To find each sign's month-days: accumulate the daily motion of 59 parts 8 seconds day by day.

sentences.zh: 內減一分四秒，或云西域中國裏差，非是，蓋系己未年之末日度應也。

translations.literal: Subtract within 1 part 4 seconds—or it is said to be the li-cha between the Western Regions and China; this is not so; it is rather the correspondence of the jìwèi year's final-day degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 1 part 4 seconds within; some call this the longitudinal difference between the Western Regions and China, but that is wrong—it is the adjustment for the jìwèi epoch's year-end degree.

sentences.zh: 求自行度 置其日中心行度，減其宮最高行度，即得。

translations.literal: To seek proper motion degree: set that day's mean longitude, subtract that sign's apogee longitude, and obtain.
translations.idiomatic: To find the proper-motion degree: set that day's mean longitude and subtract that sign's apogee longitude.

sentences.zh: 即入盈縮歷度也。

translations.literal: That is the degree entered into the expansion-contraction sequence.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the degree entered into the expansion–contraction sequence.

sentences.zh: 求加減差。

translations.literal: To seek the additive-subtractive difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the equation correction.

sentences.zh: 即盈縮差。

translations.literal: That is the expansion-contraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: This is the expansion–contraction difference.

sentences.zh: 以自行宮度爲引數，入太陽加減立成內，照引數宮度取加減差。

translations.literal: Take the proper-motion sign-degree as argument; enter the Sun additive-subtractive ready reckoner; according to the argument sign-degree take the additive-subtractive difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the proper-motion sign-degree as the argument, enter the solar equation ready reckoner, and take the correction for that sign-degree.

sentences.zh: 是名未定差。

translations.literal: This is called the undetermined difference.
translations.idiomatic: This is called the undetermined correction.

sentences.zh: 其度下小餘，用比例法，以本加減差，與後度加減差相減，餘數通爲秒，如一分通爲六十秒。

translations.literal: Beneath that degree's small remainder, use the proportional method: with this degree's additive-subtractive difference and the next degree's additive-subtractive difference subtract; the remainder convert to seconds—as one part converts to sixty seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For the fractional remainder below that degree, apply proportional interpolation: subtract this degree's correction from the next degree's correction, convert the remainder to seconds (one part equals sixty seconds),

sentences.zh: 與引數小餘亦通秒相乘，得數爲纖，秒乘秒，得纖。

translations.literal: Also convert the argument's small remainder to seconds and multiply; the product is fibre; seconds times seconds yields fibre.
translations.idiomatic: convert the argument's fractional remainder to seconds likewise and multiply; the product is in fibre units—seconds times seconds yield fibre.

sentences.zh: 以六十收之，爲微、爲秒、爲分。

translations.literal: Collect by sixty for minute-fractions, seconds, and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Collect by sixty into minute-fractions, seconds, and parts.

sentences.zh: 如數多，先以六十收之爲微，又以六十收之爲秒，又以六十收之爲分。

translations.literal: If the number is large, first collect by sixty into minute-fractions, again by sixty into seconds, again by sixty into parts.
translations.idiomatic: If the amount is large, first collect by sixty into minute-fractions, then again into seconds, then again into parts.

sentences.zh: 視前所得未定加減差數較，少於後數者後度加減差加之，多於後數者減之，是爲加減定差分。

translations.literal: Compare the undetermined additive-subtractive difference obtained above: if less than the following number, add the following degree's additive-subtractive difference; if greater, subtract—this is the fixed additive-subtractive difference in parts.
translations.idiomatic: Compare the undetermined correction obtained above with the next value: if smaller, add the next degree's correction; if larger, subtract—this yields the fixed equation correction in parts.

sentences.zh: 如無小餘，竟用未定差爲定差。

translations.literal: If there is no small remainder, directly use the undetermined difference as the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: If there is no fractional remainder, use the undetermined correction directly as the fixed correction.

sentences.zh: 後准此。

translations.literal: Later cases follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Later cases follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 求經度黃道度。

translations.literal: To seek ecliptic longitude.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 置其日中心行度，以加減定差分加減之，視定差引數自行宮度，在初宮至五宮爲減差，六宮至十一宮爲加差。

translations.literal: Set that day's mean longitude; add or subtract the fixed additive-subtractive difference in parts; viewing the fixed difference's argument proper-motion sign-degree, in signs one through five it is subtractive difference, in signs six through eleven additive difference—then obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Set that day's mean longitude and add or subtract the fixed equation correction in parts; where the argument's proper-motion sign lies in signs 1–5 the correction is subtractive, in signs 6–11 additive.

sentences.zh: 即得。

translations.literal: Then it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 求七曜 置積年入立成內，取總年零年月日下七曜數並之，累去七數，餘即所求白羊宮一日七曜。

translations.literal: To seek the seven luminaries: set accumulated years and enter the ready reckoner; take beneath total year, zero year, month, and day the seven-luminary numbers and combine; repeatedly discard sevens; the remainder is the seven luminary for Aries day one of the date sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find the planetary weekday: set the accumulated years, enter the ready reckoner, combine the weekday numbers under total years, zero years, month, and day, repeatedly discard sevens, and the remainder is the weekday for Aries day one.

sentences.zh: 如求次宮者，內加各宮七曜數。

translations.literal: If seeking the next sign, add within each sign's seven-luminary number.
translations.idiomatic: For the next sign, add that sign's weekday number within.

sentences.zh: 如求逐日，累加一數，滿七去之。

translations.literal: If seeking day by day, accumulate adding one; when full of seven discard.
translations.idiomatic: For successive days, add one each day and discard sevens when full.

sentences.zh: 求太陰、五星、羅計七曜並准此。

translations.literal: The Moon, five planets, and Rahu-Ketu seven luminaries all follow this.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon, the five planets, and Rahu–Ketu weekdays all follow this rule.

sentences.zh: ▲太陰行度

translations.literal: ▲ Lunar motion degree
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Lunar motion

sentences.zh: 求中心行度 置積年入立成內，取總零年月日下中心行度並之，得數，內減一十四分，己未應轉。

translations.literal: To seek mean longitude: set accumulated years, enter the ready reckoner, take beneath total zero year, month, and day the mean longitude and combine; obtain the number; subtract within 14 parts—the jìwèi correspondence rotation.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean longitude: set the accumulated years, enter the ready reckoner, combine the mean longitudes under total, zero years, month, and day, and subtract 14 parts within for the jìwèi epoch adjustment.

sentences.zh: 即所求年白羊宮一日中心行度。

translations.literal: That is the sought year's Aries day-one mean longitude.
translations.idiomatic: This is the mean longitude for Aries day one of the year sought.

sentences.zh: 如求逐日，累加日行度。

translations.literal: If seeking day by day, accumulate adding daily travel.
translations.idiomatic: For successive days, accumulate the daily motion.

sentences.zh: 十三度一零三五。

translations.literal: 13 degrees 10 parts 35 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Daily motion: 13°10′35″.

sentences.zh: 求加倍相離度月體在小輪行度，合朔後，與日相離。

translations.literal: To seek doubled-separation degree—the Moon's motion on the small epicycle; after conjunction, separation from the Sun.
translations.idiomatic: To find the doubled-separation degree—the Moon's motion on the epicycle, its distance from the Sun after conjunction.

sentences.zh: 置積年入立成內，取總年零年月日下加倍相離度並之，內減二十六分，即所求白羊宮一日度也。

translations.literal: Set accumulated years, enter the ready reckoner, take beneath total year, zero year, month, and day the doubled-separation and combine; subtract within 26 parts—that is the Aries day-one degree sought.
translations.idiomatic: Set the accumulated years, enter the ready reckoner, combine the doubled-separation under total years, zero years, month, and day, subtract 26 parts within, and obtain Aries day one.

sentences.zh: 如逐日，累加倍離日行度。

translations.literal: Day by day: accumulate the doubled-separation daily travel.
translations.idiomatic: For successive days, accumulate the doubled-separation daily motion.

sentences.zh: 二十四度二二五三二二，半之，即小輪心離太陽數。

translations.literal: 24 degrees 22 parts 53 seconds 22 fibre; halve it for the small-epicycle center's distance-from-Sun number.
translations.idiomatic: 24°22′53″22‴; halve this for the epicycle center's distance from the Sun.

sentences.zh: 求本輪行度即月轉度。

translations.literal: To seek deferent motion degree—that is the lunar rotation degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find deferent motion—that is the lunar rotation degree.

sentences.zh: 置積年入立成內，取總零年月日下本輪行度並之，內減一四分，即所求白羊宮一日度也。

translations.literal: Set accumulated years, enter the ready reckoner, take beneath total zero year, month, and day the deferent motion and combine; subtract within 14 parts—that is the Aries day-one degree sought.
translations.idiomatic: Set the accumulated years, enter the ready reckoner, combine deferent motion under total, zero years, month, and day, subtract 14 parts within, and obtain Aries day one.

sentences.zh: 如求各日，累加本輪日行度。

translations.literal: For each day sought, accumulate adding deferent daily travel.
translations.idiomatic: For each day sought, accumulate the deferent daily motion.

sentences.zh: 十三度三分五四。

translations.literal: 13 degrees 3 parts 54 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Daily motion: 13°3′54″.

sentences.zh: 求第一加減差又名倍離差。

translations.literal: To seek the first additive-subtractive difference, also called the doubled-separation difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the first equation correction, also called the doubled-separation correction.

sentences.zh: 以加倍相離宮度爲引數，入太陰第一加減立成內，取加減差。

translations.literal: Take the doubled-separation sign-degree as argument; enter the Moon's first additive-subtractive ready reckoner; take the additive-subtractive difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the doubled-separation sign-degree as the argument, enter the lunar first-equation ready reckoner, and take the correction.

sentences.zh: 未定差。

translations.literal: Undetermined difference.
translations.idiomatic: This is the undetermined correction.

sentences.zh: 又與下差相減，餘乘引數小余，得數爲秒，分乘分以六十收之爲分，用加減未定差，後差多加少減，同太陽。

translations.literal: Also subtract from the next difference; remainder multiply the argument's small remainder for seconds; parts times parts collect by sixty into parts; apply to the undetermined difference—next difference more add, less subtract; same as the Sun.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the next correction, multiply the remainder by the argument's fractional remainder for seconds, collect parts-times-parts by sixty into parts, and apply to the undetermined correction—add when the next value is larger, subtract when smaller, as for the Sun.

sentences.zh: 得第一分差。

translations.literal: Obtain the first difference in parts.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the first correction in parts.

sentences.zh: 求本輪行度 置其日本輪行度，以第一差分加減之。

translations.literal: To seek deferent motion degree: set that day's deferent motion; with the first difference in parts add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find deferent motion: set that day's deferent motion and add or subtract the first correction in parts.

sentences.zh: 視倍離度，前六宮加，後六宮減。

translations.literal: Viewing the doubled-separation degree, the first six signs add, the last six subtract.
translations.idiomatic: By the doubled-separation degree: add in the first six signs, subtract in the last six.

sentences.zh: 求第二加減差 以本輪行定度度爲引數，入太陰第二加減立成內，取未定差，依比例法，同前。

translations.literal: To seek the second additive-subtractive difference: take the deferent fixed-motion degree as argument; enter the Moon's second additive-subtractive ready reckoner; take the undetermined difference; by the proportional method, same as before.
translations.idiomatic: To find the second equation correction: take the deferent fixed motion as the argument, enter the lunar second-equation ready reckoner, take the undetermined correction, and interpolate proportionally as before.

sentences.zh: 求得零數加減之爲第二加減差分。

translations.literal: Obtain the zero parts and add or subtract as the second additive-subtractive difference in parts.
translations.idiomatic: Obtain the fractional part and add or subtract it as the second correction in parts.

sentences.zh: 視引數，六宮已前爲減差，後爲加差。

translations.literal: Viewing the argument, before sign six is subtractive difference, after is additive difference.
translations.idiomatic: By the argument: before sign 6 the correction is subtractive, after sign 6 additive.

sentences.zh: 求比數分 以們離宮度，入第一加減立成內，取比數分。

translations.literal: To seek ratio parts: by the doubled-separation sign-degree, enter the first additive-subtractive ready reckoner; take the ratio parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ratio parts: by the doubled-separation sign-degree, enter the first-equation ready reckoner and take the ratio parts.

sentences.zh: 如們離零分在三十分已上者，取下度比敷分。

translations.literal: If the doubled-separation zero-parts are at 30 parts or above, take the next degree's ratio parts.
translations.idiomatic: If the doubled-separation fractional part is 30 parts or more, take the next degree's ratio parts.

sentences.zh: 求遠近度 以本輪行定宮度爲引敷，入陰第二加減立成內，取遠近度分。

translations.literal: To seek proximity degree: by the deferent fixed sign-degree as argument, enter the Moon's second additive-subtractive ready reckoner; take the proximity parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the proximity correction: by the deferent fixed sign-degree as argument, enter the lunar second-equation ready reckoner and take the proximity parts.

sentences.zh: 其引數零分，亦依比例法取之。

translations.literal: The argument's zero-parts are also taken by the proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: The argument's fractional part is also obtained by proportional interpolation.

sentences.zh: 求凡差定差 置比敷分，以遠近度通分乘之，以六十約之爲分，即凡差。

translations.literal: To seek general and fixed difference: set the ratio parts; multiply by the proximity degree converted to common parts; reduce by sixty to parts—that is the general difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the general and fixed corrections: set the ratio parts, multiply by the proximity degree in common parts, and reduce by sixty to parts—this is the general correction.

sentences.zh: 以凡差加入第二加減差，即爲定差。

translations.literal: Add the general difference to the second additive-subtractive difference—that is the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Add the general correction to the second correction to obtain the fixed correction.

sentences.zh: 求經度 置其日太陰中心行度，以定差加減之，即太陰經度。

translations.literal: To seek longitude: set that day's lunar mean longitude; add or subtract the fixed difference—that is the lunar longitude.
translations.idiomatic: To find longitude: set that day's lunar mean longitude, add or subtract the fixed correction, and obtain the lunar longitude.

sentences.zh: 視本輪行定前減，以後加。

translations.literal: Viewing the deferent fixed motion: before subtract, after add.
translations.idiomatic: By the deferent fixed motion: subtract before, add after.

sentences.zh: ▲太陰緯度

translations.literal: ▲ Lunar latitude
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Lunar latitude

sentences.zh: 求計都與月相離度入交定度。

translations.literal: To seek Rahu-Moon separation degree entering nodal fixed degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the Rahu–Moon separation and nodal fixed degree.

sentences.zh: 置其日太限經度，內減其日計都行度，即計都與月相離度分。

translations.literal: Set that day's lunar longitude; subtract within that day's Rahu motion degree—that is the Rahu-Moon separation in parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set that day's lunar longitude and subtract that day's Rahu motion within to obtain the Rahu–Moon separation in parts.

sentences.zh: 求緯 以計都與月相離宮度爲引數，入太陰緯度立成，上宮用右行順度，下宮用左行逆度。

translations.literal: To seek latitude: by the Rahu-Moon separation sign-degree as argument, enter the lunar-latitude ready reckoner; upper signs use right-motion direct degrees, lower signs use left-motion retrograde degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find latitude: take the Rahu–Moon separation sign-degree as the argument, enter the lunar-latitude ready reckoner—upper signs use right-motion direct degrees, lower signs left-motion retrograde degrees.

sentences.zh: 取其度分，依比例法求得零分加減之，上六宮加，下六宮減。

translations.literal: Take the degree-parts; by the proportional method obtain the zero-parts and add or subtract; upper six signs add, lower six subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Take the degree and parts, interpolate the fractional part proportionally, and add in the upper six signs or subtract in the lower six.

sentences.zh: 得緯度分。

translations.literal: Obtain the latitude in parts.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the latitude in parts.

sentences.zh: 引數在六宮已前爲黃道北，六宮後爲黃道南。

translations.literal: Argument before sign six is north of the ecliptic; after sign six is south of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Arguments before sign 6 yield north latitude; after sign 6, south latitude.

sentences.zh: 求計羅行度 置積年入總年零年月日立成內，取羅計中心行度並之，爲其年白羊宮一日行度。

translations.literal: To seek Rahu motion: set accumulated years in the total year, zero year, month, and day ready reckoner; take the Rahu center motion and combine—as that year's Aries day-one motion.
translations.idiomatic: To find Rahu's motion: set the accumulated years in the ready reckoner for total, zero years, month, and day, combine the Rahu mean motions, and obtain Aries day-one motion for that year.

sentences.zh: 求各宮一日，以各宮日行度加之，與十二宮相減，餘即所求宮一日計都行度。

translations.literal: For each sign's day one: add each sign's daily travel; subtract from the twelve signs—the remainder is the sought sign's day-one Rahu motion.
translations.idiomatic: For each sign's first day: add that sign's daily motion and subtract from twelve signs; the remainder is Rahu's motion for that sign's day one.

sentences.zh: 如求計都逐日細行，以前後二段行度相減，餘以相距日數除之，爲日差。

translations.literal: If seeking Rahu day-by-day fine motion: subtract the prior and posterior segment motions; divide the remainder by the days between for the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Rahu's day-by-day fine motion: subtract the prior and following segment motions and divide the remainder by the intervening days to obtain the daily increment.

sentences.zh: 又置前段計都行度，以日差累減之。

translations.literal: Also set the prior segment's Rahu motion; accumulate subtracting the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the prior segment's Rahu motion and accumulate, subtracting the daily increment each day.

sentences.zh: 如求羅喉行度，置其日計都行度內。

translations.literal: If seeking Ketu motion: set within that day's Rahu motion.
translations.idiomatic: For Ketu's motion: set it within that day's Rahu motion (opposite).

sentences.zh: ▲五星經度

translations.literal: ▲ Five planets' longitude
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Longitude of the five planets

sentences.zh: 求最高總度 數同太陽，依前太陽術求之。

translations.literal: To seek apogee total degree: the count is the same as the Sun; seek by the prior Sun procedure.
translations.idiomatic: To find apogee total degree: the reckoning matches the Sun; apply the solar procedure above.

sentences.zh: 求最高行度 置所求本星最高總度，加測定本星最高行度，見前。

translations.literal: To seek apogee motion: set the sought planet's apogee total degree; add the observed fixed planet apogee motion (see above)—as that year's Aries apogee motion.
translations.idiomatic: To find apogee motion: set the planet's apogee total degree, add the observed fixed apogee motion (see above), and obtain that year's Aries apogee motion.

sentences.zh: 爲其年白羊 最高行度。

translations.literal: Aries highest motion degree.
translations.idiomatic: This is the apogee motion for Aries day one of the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求扣宮各日，加各宮日行度。

translations.literal: To seek each sign each day, add each sign's daily travel.
translations.idiomatic: For each sign and day, add that sign's daily motion.

sentences.zh: 求日中心行度 依太陽術求之。

translations.literal: To seek mean longitude: by the Sun procedure.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean longitude: follow the solar procedure.

sentences.zh: 求自行度 置積年入立成總零年月日下，各取自行度並之，得其年白羊宮一日自行度。

translations.literal: To seek proper motion: set accumulated years in the ready reckoner beneath total, zero year, month, and day; take each proper motion and combine—that year's Aries day-one proper motion.
translations.idiomatic: To find proper motion: set accumulated years in the ready reckoner, combine each planet's proper motion under total, zero years, month, and day, and obtain Aries day-one proper motion for that year.

sentences.zh: 土、木、金三星減一分，水星減三分，火星不減。

translations.literal: Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus subtract 1 part; Mercury subtracts 3 parts; Mars does not subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus subtract 1 part; Mercury subtracts 3 parts; Mars subtracts none.

sentences.zh: 如求各宮各日，照本星自行度累加之。

translations.literal: For each sign and each day sought, accumulate adding that planet's proper motion.
translations.idiomatic: For each sign and day, accumulate that planet's proper motion.

sentences.zh: 水星如自行度遇三宮初度，作五日一段算，至九宮初度，作十日一段算緯度亦然。

translations.literal: Mercury: when proper motion reaches sign three's initial degree, compute in five-day segments; reaching sign nine's initial degree, compute in ten-day segments—latitude likewise.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury: from sign 3's initial degree compute in five-day segments; from sign 9's initial degree in ten-day segments—the same for latitude.

sentences.zh: 求中心行度中輪心度即入歷度五星本輪。

translations.literal: To seek mean longitude center-epicycle degree—that is the entered-sequence degree of the five planets' deferent.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean longitude and epicycle-center degree—that is the five planets' deferent entry into the sequence.

sentences.zh: 土、木、火三星，置太陽中心行度，減其星自行度，爲三星中心行度。

translations.literal: Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars: set the Sun's mean longitude, subtract that planet's proper motion—for the three planets' mean longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars: set the Sun's mean longitude and subtract the planet's proper motion to obtain mean longitude.

sentences.zh: 內又減最高行度，爲三星小輪心度。

translations.literal: Within also subtract apogee motion—for the three planets' small-epicycle center degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract apogee motion within as well to obtain the epicycle-center degree.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星，其中心行度即太陽中心行度，內減其星最高行度，餘爲其星小輪心度。

translations.literal: Venus and Mercury: their mean longitude is the Sun's mean longitude; subtract that planet's apogee motion within—the remainder is that planet's small-epicycle center degree.
translations.idiomatic: Venus and Mercury: mean longitude equals the Sun's mean longitude; subtract the planet's apogee within—the remainder is the epicycle-center degree.

sentences.zh: 不及減，加十二宮減之。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, add twelve signs and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, add twelve signs and subtract.

sentences.zh: 求第一加減差盈縮差。

translations.literal: To seek the first additive-subtractive difference, expansion-contraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the first equation correction—the expansion–contraction difference.

sentences.zh: 以其星小輪心宮度爲引數，入本星第一加減立成，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: By that planet's small-epicycle center sign-degree as argument, enter that planet's first additive-subtractive ready reckoner; seek by the proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: Take the planet's epicycle-center sign-degree as the argument, enter its first-equation ready reckoner, and interpolate proportionally.

sentences.zh: 法同太陽、太陰。

translations.literal: Method same as Sun and Moon.
translations.idiomatic: The method matches the Sun and Moon.

sentences.zh: 求自行定度及小輪心定度 視第一加減差引數，在初宮至五宮，用加減差，加自行度，減小輪心度，各爲定度。

translations.literal: To seek proper-motion fixed degree and small-epicycle-center fixed degree: viewing the first additive-subtractive difference's argument, in signs one through five use the additive-subtractive difference to add to proper motion and subtract from small-epicycle center—each becomes fixed degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed proper motion and fixed epicycle center: where the first correction's argument lies in signs 1–5, add the correction to proper motion and subtract from the epicycle center—each yields a fixed degree.

sentences.zh: 在六宮至一宮，用加減差，減自行度，加小輪心度，各爲定度。

translations.literal: In signs six through eleven use the additive-subtractive difference to subtract from proper motion and add to small-epicycle center—each becomes fixed degree.
translations.idiomatic: In signs 6–11, subtract the correction from proper motion and add to the epicycle center—each yields a fixed degree.

sentences.zh: 求第二加減差 以其星自行定度，入本第二加減立成內，取其度分，用比例法加減之。

translations.literal: To seek the second additive-subtractive difference: by that planet's proper-motion fixed degree, enter that planet's second additive-subtractive ready reckoner; take its degree-parts; add or subtract by the proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the second equation correction: by the planet's fixed proper motion, enter its second-equation ready reckoner, take degree and parts, and add or subtract proportionally.

sentences.zh: 同前。

translations.literal: Same as before.
translations.idiomatic: Same as before.

sentences.zh: 求比敷分 如土、木、金、水星，以本星小輪心一宮度，入第一加減立成內，取比敷分，如引數小餘在三十分已上，取手行經敷分。

translations.literal: To seek ratio parts: for Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury, by that planet's small-epicycle center one sign-degree, enter the first additive-subtractive ready reckoner; take ratio parts; if the argument's small remainder is at 30 parts or above, take the next degree's motion ratio parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find ratio parts: for Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury, by the epicycle center's sign-degree enter the first-equation ready reckoner; if the argument's fractional part is 30 parts or more, take the next degree's ratio parts.

sentences.zh: 如火星，則必用比例法求之。

translations.literal: For Mars, one must seek by the proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: For Mars, the proportional method must be used throughout.

sentences.zh: 求遠近度 以自行定宮度，入第二加減立成內，取遠近度，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: To seek proximity degree: by the proper-motion fixed sign-degree, enter the second additive-subtractive ready reckoner; take proximity degree; seek by the proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: To find proximity correction: by fixed proper-motion sign-degree, enter the second-equation ready reckoner, take the proximity value, and interpolate proportionally.

sentences.zh: 求凡差定差 法同太陰。

translations.literal: To seek general and fixed difference: method same as the Moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find general and fixed corrections: same method as the Moon.

sentences.zh: 求經度 置小輪心定度，以定差加減之，視引數自行定度，在六宮已前加，已後減。

translations.literal: To seek longitude: set the small-epicycle-center fixed degree; add or subtract the fixed difference; viewing the argument proper-motion fixed degree, before sign six add, after subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find longitude: set the fixed epicycle-center degree, add or subtract the fixed correction—add before sign 6 by the fixed proper-motion argument, subtract after.

sentences.zh: 內加其星最高行度。

translations.literal: Within add that planet's apogee motion.
translations.idiomatic: Add the planet's apogee motion within.

sentences.zh: 求留段 以其段小輪心，定宮諜爲引數，即立成內各星入歷定限。

translations.literal: To seek station segment: by that segment's small-epicycle-center fixed sign-degree as argument, enter the ready reckoner each planet's sequence fixed limit.
translations.idiomatic: To find the station interval: take that segment's fixed epicycle-center sign-degree as the argument and enter each planet's sequence fixed limit in the ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 入五星順退留立成內，於同宮近度，取本星度分，與前後行查減。

translations.literal: Enter the five planets' direct-retrograde-station ready reckoner; at the same sign's nearest degree take that planet's degree-parts; subtract from prior and posterior motion.
translations.idiomatic: Enter the five-planet direct, retrograde, and station ready reckoner; at the nearest degree in the same sign take the planet's degree-parts and subtract from the prior and following motions.

sentences.zh: 若取得在初宮至六宮，本行與後行相減。

translations.literal: If obtained in signs one through six, this motion minus the posterior motion.
translations.idiomatic: If the result falls in signs 1–6, subtract the following motion from this motion.

sentences.zh: 六宮至初宮，本行與與前行相減。

translations.literal: Signs six through one, this motion minus the prior motion.
translations.idiomatic: From sign 6 back to sign 1, subtract the prior motion from this motion.

sentences.zh: 又以引數宮度，減立成內同宮近度，兩減，餘通分相乘，用六度除之，立成內每隔六度。

translations.literal: Also subtract the ready reckoner's same-sign nearest degree from the argument sign-degree; the two remainders convert to common parts and multiply; divide by six—the ready reckoner has an interval every six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the ready reckoner's nearest degree in the same sign from the argument sign-degree; convert both remainders to common parts, multiply, and divide by six (the table's six-degree interval).

sentences.zh: 六十分收之，順加逆減於前取度分，得數與其日自行定度同者，即本日留。

translations.literal: Collect sixty parts; direct motion add, retrograde subtract from the prior taken degree-parts; when the number equals that day's proper fixed degree, that day is station.
translations.idiomatic: Collect by sixty parts; add for direct motion or subtract for retrograde from the prior degree-parts; when the result equals that day's fixed proper motion, that day is a station.

sentences.zh: 如自行定度多者已過留日，少者未到留日。

translations.literal: If the proper fixed degree is greater, the station day has passed; if less, the station day has not yet arrived.
translations.idiomatic: If fixed proper motion is greater, the station day has passed; if less, it has not yet arrived.

sentences.zh: 欲得細率，以所得數與其人日自行定度相減，餘以各星一日自行度約之，如土星一日自行五下七分有奇之類。

translations.literal: To obtain the fine ratio: subtract the obtained number from that day's proper-motion determined degree; divide the remainder by each planet's one-day proper motion—as with Saturn's one-day proper motion of 5 and a fraction under 7, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: To obtain the fine ratio, subtract the value found from that day's proper-motion determined degree and divide the remainder by the planet's daily proper motion—for example, Saturn's daily proper motion of about 5°7′.

sentences.zh: 即得留日在本日前後數也。

translations.literal: Then obtain the number of days before or after the station day on the current day.
translations.idiomatic: The result is how many days before or after station fall on the current day.

sentences.zh: 土星留七日，其留日前三日，後三日，皆與留日數同。

translations.literal: Saturn stations for seven days; the three days before and three days after the station day are the same as the station-day count.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn stations for seven days; the three days before and after the station day match the station count.

sentences.zh: 木星留五日，其留日前二日，後二二與留日數同。

translations.literal: Jupiter stations for five days; the two days before and two days after are the same as the station-day count.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter stations for five days; the two days before and after match the station count.

sentences.zh: 火、金、水三星不留，退而即退，但於行分極處留耳。

translations.literal: Mars, Venus, and Mercury do not station; when they retrograde they immediately retrograde—they station only at the extremity of motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Mars, Venus, and Mercury do not truly station; once retrograde begins they continue retrograde, pausing only at the extremity of their motion parts.

sentences.zh: 求細行分 土、木、金、火四星，以前後兩段經度相減，以相距除之爲日行分。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive fine motion parts—For Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, and Mars: subtract the longitudes of the prior and subsequent segments; divide the remainder by the interval to obtain daily motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive fine motion parts: for Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, and Mars, subtract prior and subsequent segment longitudes and divide by the interval to obtain daily motion parts.

sentences.zh: 水星以白羊宮初日經度，又與前一日經度相減，餘爲初日行分。

translations.literal: For Mercury: subtract the longitude on the first day of Aries from that of the day before; the remainder is the initial day's motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury, subtract the prior day's longitude from the Aries-first-day longitude; the remainder is the initial day's motion parts.

sentences.zh: 又置前後二段經度相減，餘以相距日除之，爲平行分。

translations.literal: Again set the prior and subsequent segment longitudes, subtract, and divide the remainder by the interval days to obtain parallel motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Again subtract prior and subsequent segment longitudes and divide by the interval to obtain parallel motion parts.

sentences.zh: 與初日行分加減，倍之，以前段前一日與後段相距日數除之之爲日差。

translations.literal: Add or subtract with the initial day's motion parts, double it, and divide by the number of days from the day before the prior segment to the interval of the subsequent segment—to obtain the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the initial day's motion parts, double the result, and divide by the days from the day before the prior segment to the subsequent interval to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 以加減初日行分，初日行分少於平行分加，多減。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to the initial day's motion parts: if the initial day's motion parts are less than the parallel motion parts, add; if more, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract from the initial day's motion parts: if they are less than the parallel motion parts, add; if greater, subtract.

sentences.zh: 爲日行分。

translations.literal: This yields the daily motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the daily motion parts.

sentences.zh: 五星各置前段經度，以逐日行分順加退減之，爲各星逐日經度。

translations.literal: For each of the five planets, set the prior segment's longitude and add or subtract the daily motion parts in forward or reverse order to obtain each planet's day-by-day longitude.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, set the prior segment's longitude and add or subtract daily motion parts forward or backward to obtain day-by-day longitudes.

sentences.zh: 求伏見 視各星自行定度，在伏見立成內限度已上者，即五星晨夕伏見也。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive concealment and visibility—Inspect each planet's proper-motion determined degree; if it is above the limit within the concealment-and-visibility ready reckoner, that is morning or evening concealment or visibility for the five planets.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive concealment and visibility: if a planet's proper-motion determined degree lies above the limit in the concealment-and-visibility ready reckoner, that marks morning or evening concealment or visibility.

sentences.zh: 五星緯度求最高總行度、中心行度、自行度、小輪度，並依五星比經度術求之。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the five planets' latitudes—Derive total travel degree at apogee, center travel degree, proper-motion degree, and epicycle degree—all by the five-planet ratio-longitude procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the five planets' latitudes: obtain apogee total travel, center travel, proper-motion, and epicycle degrees by the five-planet ratio-longitude method.

sentences.zh: 求自行定度 置自行宮度分，其宮以一十乘爲度。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive proper-motion determined degree—Set proper-motion mansion degrees and minutes; multiply the mansion by ten to obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the proper-motion determined degree: set proper-motion mansion degrees and minutes and multiply the mansion by ten for degrees.

sentences.zh: 如一宮，以十乘之得十度，此用約法折算，以造緯度立成。

translations.literal: For one mansion, multiplying by ten gives ten degrees—this uses a rounding method to compile the latitude ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: One mansion times ten yields ten degrees; this rounding shortcut builds the latitude ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 其度以二十乘之爲分，滿六十約之爲度。

translations.literal: Multiply the degrees by twenty to obtain minutes; when full divide by sixty to obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply degrees by twenty for minutes and, when full, reduce by sixty to degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分亦以二十乘之爲秒，滿六十約之屬分。

translations.literal: Multiply the minutes by twenty to obtain seconds; when full divide by sixty to obtain minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply minutes by twenty for seconds and, when full, reduce by sixty to minutes.

sentences.zh: 並之即得。

translations.literal: Combine them to obtain the result.
translations.idiomatic: Combine them to obtain the value.

sentences.zh: 求小輪心定度 置小輪心宮度分，其宮以五乘之爲度。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive epicycle-center determined degree—Set epicycle-center mansion degrees and minutes; multiply the mansion by five to obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the epicycle-center determined degree: set epicycle-center mansion degrees and minutes and multiply the mansion by five for degrees.

sentences.zh: 如一宮以五乘之，得五度。

translations.literal: For one mansion, multiplying by five gives five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: One mansion times five yields five degrees.

sentences.zh: 其度以一十乘之爲分，滿六十約之迷度。

translations.literal: Multiply the degrees by ten to obtain minutes; when full divide by sixty to obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply degrees by ten for minutes and, when full, reduce by sixty to degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分亦以一十乘之爲秒，滿六十約之爲分。

translations.literal: Multiply the minutes by ten to obtain seconds; when full divide by sixty to obtain minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply minutes by ten for seconds and, when full, reduce by sixty to minutes.

sentences.zh: 並之即得。

translations.literal: Combine them to obtain the result.
translations.idiomatic: Combine them to obtain the value.

sentences.zh: 求緯度 以小輪心定度及自行度，入本星緯度立成內兩取，一縱一橫。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive latitude—Using epicycle-center determined degree and proper-motion degree, enter the planet's latitude ready reckoner and take two values, one vertical and one horizontal.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive latitude: with epicycle-center and proper-motion determined degrees, enter the planet's latitude ready reckoner and take one vertical and one horizontal value.

sentences.zh: 得數與後行相減。

translations.literal: Subtract the obtained number from the lower row.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the value taken from the lower row.

sentences.zh: 若遇交黃道者，與後行相併。

translations.literal: If crossing the ecliptic, add to the lower row instead.
translations.idiomatic: If the planet crosses the ecliptic, add to the lower row instead.

sentences.zh: 又以小輪心定立成上小輪心定相減，上橫行。

translations.literal: Again subtract the epicycle-center determined value on the ready reckoner from the upper epicycle-center determined value—the upper horizontal row.
translations.idiomatic: Again subtract the upper epicycle-center determined value on the ready reckoner from the epicycle-center determined value in the upper horizontal row.

sentences.zh: 兩減餘相乘，以立成上小輪心度累加數除之。

translations.literal: Multiply the two differences; divide by the cumulative-add number for epicycle-center degree on the ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the two remainders and divide by the epicycle-center cumulative increment on the ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 如土星上橫行小輪心度每隔三度，火星每隔二度之類。

translations.literal: As with Saturn's upper horizontal row where epicycle-center degree increases every three degrees, Mars every two degrees, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: For example, Saturn's upper horizontal row steps epicycle-center degree every three degrees and Mars every two.

sentences.zh: 滿六十收之爲分，用加減兩取數，多於後行減，少加。

translations.literal: Collect by sixty into minutes; use to add or subtract the two taken values—if greater than the lower row subtract, if less add.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce by sixty to minutes and add or subtract the two values: if greater than the lower row, subtract; if less, add.

sentences.zh: 若遇交黃道者，即後行數多亦減。

translations.literal: If crossing the ecliptic, even when the lower-row number is greater, still subtract.
translations.idiomatic: At ecliptic crossing, subtract even when the lower-row value is larger.

sentences.zh: 寄左。

translations.literal: Store on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Set aside on the left.

sentences.zh: 復以自行定度與立成上自行定度相減，首直行。

translations.literal: Again subtract the proper-motion determined degree from the proper-motion determined degree on the ready reckoner—the first vertical row.
translations.idiomatic: Again subtract the ready-reckoner proper-motion determined degree in the first vertical row from the proper-motion determined degree.

sentences.zh: 又以兩取數，與下行相減，若遇交黃道埏，與下行並。

translations.literal: Again with the two taken values, subtract from the lower row; if crossing the ecliptic, combine with the lower row.
translations.idiomatic: With the two values again, subtract from the lower row; at ecliptic crossing, add to the lower row.

sentences.zh: 兩減餘相乘，以立成上自行度累加數除之，如土星直行，自行度每隔十度，火星每隔四度之類。

translations.literal: Multiply the two differences; divide by the cumulative-add number for proper-motion degree on the ready reckoner—as with Saturn's vertical row where proper-motion degree increases every ten degrees, Mars every four degrees, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the two remainders and divide by the proper-motion cumulative increment—as when Saturn's vertical row steps every ten degrees and Mars every four.

sentences.zh: 收之爲分。

translations.literal: Collect into minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce to minutes.

sentences.zh: 與前寄左數相加減，如兩取數多於下行者減，少加。

translations.literal: Add or subtract with the previously stored left value: if the two taken values exceed the lower row subtract, if less add.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the left-stored value: if the two values exceed the lower row, subtract; if less, add.

sentences.zh: 若遇交黃者，所得分多於寄左數，置所得分內，減寄左數，餘爲交過黃道南北分也。

translations.literal: If crossing the ecliptic and the resulting minutes exceed the left-stored value, set within the resulting minutes and subtract the left-stored value; the remainder is the minutes past the ecliptic to north or south.
translations.idiomatic: At ecliptic crossing, if the new minutes exceed the left-stored amount, subtract the left-stored amount from the result; the remainder is the arc north or south of the ecliptic crossed.

sentences.zh: 即得黃道南北緯定分。

translations.literal: Then obtain the fixed minutes of ecliptic north or south latitude.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the fixed ecliptic latitude north or south.

sentences.zh: 求緯度細行分 置其星前段緯度，與後段緯度相減，餘以相距日除之，爲日差。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive fine latitude daily motion parts—Set the planet's prior-segment latitude and subtract from the subsequent-segment latitude; divide the remainder by the interval days for the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive fine latitude daily motion: subtract prior-segment from subsequent-segment latitude and divide by the interval for the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 置前段緯度，以日差順加退減，即逐日緯度分。

translations.literal: Set the prior-segment latitude and add or subtract the daily difference in forward or reverse order to obtain day-by-day latitude minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Set the prior-segment latitude and add or subtract the daily difference forward or backward for day-by-day latitude.

sentences.zh: 按緯度前段少於後段者，以日差順加退減。

translations.literal: When the prior segment's latitude is less than the subsequent segment's, add forward and subtract in reverse.
translations.idiomatic: When the prior latitude is less than the subsequent, add forward and subtract backward.

sentences.zh: 若前段多於後段者，宜以日差順減退加。

translations.literal: When the prior exceeds the subsequent, one should subtract forward and add in reverse.
translations.idiomatic: When the prior exceeds the subsequent, subtract forward and add backward.

sentences.zh: 非可一例也。

translations.literal: This cannot be applied uniformly in one rule.
translations.idiomatic: The two cases cannot share one rule.

sentences.zh: 若前後段南北不同者，置其星前後段緯度並之，以相距日除之，爲日差。

translations.literal: When prior and subsequent segments differ in north or south, set the planet's prior and subsequent latitudes together and divide by interval days for the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: When north and south differ between segments, add prior and subsequent latitudes and divide by the interval for the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 置前段緯度，以日差累減之，至不及減者，於日差內減之，餘以日差累加之，即得逐日緯度。

translations.literal: Set prior-segment latitude and subtract the daily difference cumulatively; when subtraction fails, subtract within the daily difference and cumulatively add the remainder—to obtain day-by-day latitude.
translations.idiomatic: Set the prior latitude and subtract the daily difference repeatedly; when subtraction fails, take the remainder from the daily difference and add forward to obtain day-by-day latitude.

sentences.zh: 推日食法日食諸數，如午前合朔，用前一日數推，午後合朔，用次日數推。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive solar eclipses—For solar eclipse parameters, if conjunction before noon use the prior day's numbers; if after noon use the next day's numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive solar eclipses: for eclipse parameters, use the prior day's values for pre-noon conjunction and the next day's for post-noon conjunction.

sentences.zh: 辨日食限視合朔太陰緯度，在黃道南四十五分已下，黃道北九十分已下，爲人食。

translations.literal: Discern solar-eclipse limits—Inspect at conjunction the Moon's latitude relative to the ecliptic: south of the ecliptic at 45 minutes or below, north at 90 minutes or below—that is an eclipse visible to observers.
translations.idiomatic: Discern eclipse limits: at conjunction, if lunar latitude is within 45′ south or 90′ north of the ecliptic, the eclipse is visible on Earth.

sentences.zh: 若合朔爲盡，則全見食。

translations.literal: If conjunction is total, the eclipse is fully visible.
translations.idiomatic: If conjunction is total, the eclipse is seen in full.

sentences.zh: 若膈朔在日未出三時及日已入十五分，一時四分之一。

translations.literal: If the obscured new moon is three watches before the Sun has risen or 15 minutes after the Sun has set—one watch and a quarter.
translations.idiomatic: If the obscured new moon falls three watches before sunrise or a watch and a quarter (15 minutes) after sunset,

sentences.zh: 皆有帶食。

translations.literal: In all cases there is a partial eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: there is a partial eclipse in every case.

sentences.zh: 若合朔在夜刻者不算。

translations.literal: If conjunction falls in the night watches, do not calculate.
translations.idiomatic: If conjunction falls in the night watches, do not compute it.

sentences.zh: 求食甚凡時即合朔。

translations.literal: Derive greatest-eclipse general time—which is conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the greatest-eclipse general time, which is conjunction.

sentences.zh: 置午正太陰行過太陽度，求法見後月食太陰逐時行過太陽分。

translations.literal: Set the Moon's degrees past the Sun at noon standard; the procedure appears under lunar eclipse 'Moon's degrees past the Sun by watch.'
translations.idiomatic: Set the Moon's longitude past the Sun at noon; see the lunar-eclipse procedure for the Moon's hourly motion past the Sun.

sentences.zh: 通秒，以二十四乘之爲實，置太陰日行度，減太陽日行度，通秒爲法，除之爲時。

translations.literal: Unify to seconds; multiply by twenty-four for dividend; set lunar daily motion subtract solar daily motion, unify seconds as divisor; divide for hours.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to seconds, multiply by 24 for the dividend, subtract solar from lunar daily motion (also in seconds) for the divisor, and divide to obtain hours.

sentences.zh: 時下零數以六下通之爲分，分下零數以六十通之爲秒，三十秒已上收爲一分，六十分收爲一時，共爲食甚凡時。

translations.literal: Below the hour, unify the remainder to minutes; below minutes unify to seconds; at thirty seconds or above collect into one minute; at sixty minutes collect into one hour—together this is greatest-eclipse general time.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the remainder below the hour to minutes and below minutes to seconds; carry at 30″ to the minute and 60′ to the hour—the sum is the greatest-eclipse general time.

sentences.zh: 求各朔太陽經度 以食甚凡時通分，以太陽日行度通秒乘之，以二十四除之爲秒，滿六十約之爲秒分，用加減午正太陽度，午前合朔減之，午後加之。

translations.literal: Derive each conjunction's solar longitude—Unify greatest-eclipse general time to minutes; multiply by solar daily motion in seconds; divide by twenty-four for seconds; when full sixty reduce to minute-seconds; add or subtract to noon-standard solar degree—before-noon conjunction subtract, after-noon add.
translations.idiomatic: Derive solar longitude at each conjunction: convert greatest-eclipse general time to minutes, multiply by solar daily motion in seconds, divide by 24, reduce by 60, and add or subtract from noon solar longitude—subtract before noon, add after.

sentences.zh: 得合朔時太陽經度。

translations.literal: Obtain solar longitude at conjunction time.
translations.idiomatic: The result is solar longitude at conjunction.

sentences.zh: 即食甚日躔黃道度。

translations.literal: Which is the ecliptic degree of the day of greatest eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: This is the ecliptic degree on the day of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求加減分 視合朔時太陽宮度，入晝夜加減立成內，取加減分，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: Derive add-subtract parts—Inspect solar mansion at conjunction, enter within the latitude-longitude hourly add-subtract ready reckoner, take add-subtract parts, derive by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: Derive add-subtract parts: at conjunction, enter the solar mansion in the latitude-longitude hourly add-subtract ready reckoner and obtain the parts by proportional method.

sentences.zh: 求子正至合朔時分秒 置食甚凡時，以加減分分加減之，午前合朔減，午後加。

translations.literal: Derive from midnight standard to conjunction minutes and seconds—Set greatest-eclipse general time and add or subtract by add-subtract minutes—before-noon conjunction subtract, after-noon add.
translations.idiomatic: Derive midnight-to-conjunction time: set greatest-eclipse general time and add or subtract the add-subtract minutes—subtract before noon, add after.

sentences.zh: 用加減十二時，午前合朔用減十二時，午後用加十二時。

translations.literal: Use to add or subtract twelve hours—before-noon conjunction use subtract twelve hours, after-noon use add twelve hours.
translations.idiomatic: Then add or subtract twelve hours—subtract twelve for pre-noon conjunction, add twelve for post-noon.

sentences.zh: 即子正至合朔時分秒。

translations.literal: Then midnight standard to conjunction minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The result is midnight-to-conjunction time in minutes and seconds.

sentences.zh: 按命時起子正，乃變其術以劍《大統》，非其本法也。

translations.literal: Note: reckoning time from midnight standard alters the method to pare away the Datong—this is not the original method.
translations.idiomatic: Note: reckoning from midnight standard alters the procedure to match the Datong calendar and departs from the original method.

sentences.zh: 求第一東西差經差。

translations.literal: Derive the first east-west difference—longitude difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the first east-west (longitude) difference.

sentences.zh: 視合朔時，太陽宮在立成經緯時加減立成右七宮取上行時，順行。

translations.literal: At conjunction, if the solar mansion is in the right seven mansions of the ready reckoner for latitude-longitude hourly add-subtract, take the upper-row hourly value—direct motion.
translations.idiomatic: At conjunction, if the solar mansion lies in the right seven mansions of the hourly add-subtract ready reckoner, take the upper-row hourly value for direct motion.

sentences.zh: 在左七宮取下行時，逆行。

translations.literal: In the left seven mansions take the lower-row hourly value—retrograde.
translations.idiomatic: In the left seven mansions take the lower-row hourly value for retrograde motion.

sentences.zh: 以子正至合朔時，取經差，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: From midnight standard to conjunction time, take longitude difference and derive by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: From midnight to conjunction, take the longitude difference and apply the proportional method.

sentences.zh: 止用時下小餘求之。

translations.literal: Use only the fractional remainder below the hour to derive.
translations.idiomatic: Use only the fractional remainder below the hour.

sentences.zh: 下同。

translations.literal: The same below.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies below.

sentences.zh: 第一東西差。

translations.literal: First east-west difference.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the first east-west difference.

sentences.zh: 求第二東西差 視合朔時，太陽宮在立成內，同上。

translations.literal: Derive the second east-west difference—At conjunction, if solar mansion is within the ready reckoner, same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the second east-west difference: at conjunction, if the solar mansion lies in the ready reckoner, proceed as above.

sentences.zh: 取次宮子正至合朔時經差，依比例法求之，爲第二東西差。

translations.literal: Take the next mansion's midnight-to-conjunction longitude difference; derive by proportional method—for second east-west difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the next mansion's midnight-to-conjunction longitude difference and apply the proportional method to obtain the second east-west difference.

sentences.zh: 求第一南北差緯差。

translations.literal: Derive the first north-south difference—latitude difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the first north-south (latitude) difference.

sentences.zh: 以合朔時，太陽宮及子正，至合朔時入立成內，同上。

translations.literal: At conjunction, solar mansion and midnight to conjunction—enter ready reckoner, same as above.
translations.idiomatic: At conjunction, with solar mansion and midnight-to-conjunction time, enter the ready reckoner as above.

sentences.zh: 取緯差，依比例法求之，爲第一南北差。

translations.literal: Take latitude difference; derive by proportional method—for first north-south difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the latitude difference and apply the proportional method to obtain the first north-south difference.

sentences.zh: 求第二南北差 以合朔太陽宮，取次宮子正至合朔時緯差，依比例法求之，爲第二南北差。
