translations.literal: Derive second north-south difference—Using conjunction solar mansion, take next mansion's midnight-to-conjunction latitude difference; derive by proportional method—for second north-south difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the second north-south difference: with the conjunction solar mansion, take the next mansion's midnight-to-conjunction latitude difference by proportional method.

sentences.zh: 求第二時差 以膈朔太陽宮及子正至膈朔時，入立成取時差，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: Derive second time difference—Using obscured-new-moon solar mansion and midnight to obscured new moon, enter ready reckoner and take time difference; derive by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the second time difference: with the obscured-new-moon solar mansion and midnight-to-obscured-new-moon time, enter the ready reckoner, take the time difference, and apply the proportional method.

sentences.zh: 第二時差 公合朔太陽宮，取次宮子正至合朔時時差差，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: Second time difference—Using conjunction solar mansion, take next mansion's midnight-to-conjunction time difference; derive by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: For the second time difference, with the conjunction solar mansion take the next mansion's midnight-to-conjunction time difference by proportional method.

sentences.zh: 求合朔時東西差 以第一東西差與第二東西差相減，餘通秒，以乘合朔時太陽度分，亦通秒。

translations.literal: Derive east-west difference at conjunction—Subtract second from first east-west difference; unify seconds; multiply by conjunction-time solar degrees also unified to seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Derive east-west difference at conjunction: subtract the second from the first east-west difference, convert to seconds, and multiply by conjunction solar longitude in seconds.

sentences.zh: 以三十度除之爲纖，以六十收之爲微、爲秒、爲分、經加減第一東西差，視第一東西差數少於第二差者加已，多者減之，下同。

translations.literal: Divide by thirty degrees for filaments; collect by sixty into micro, seconds, minutes; add or subtract to first east-west difference—if first is less than second add, if more subtract; same below.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 30° for filaments, reduce by 60 to micro, seconds, and minutes, and add or subtract from the first east-west difference—add if the first is less than the second, subtract if greater; the same below.

sentences.zh: 爲合朔時東西差。

translations.literal: This is east-west difference at conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the east-west difference at conjunction.

sentences.zh: 求合朔時南北差 以第一南北差與第南北差相減，餘通秒，以乘太陽度分，以三十除之爲纖，依率收之爲微、秒、分，以加減第一南北差，爲各朔時南北差。

translations.literal: Derive north-south difference at conjunction—Subtract first and second north-south differences; multiply remainder unified to seconds by solar degrees; divide by thirty for filaments; collect by rate into micro, seconds, minutes; add or subtract to first north-south difference—for each conjunction's north-south difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive north-south difference at conjunction: subtract the two north-south differences, convert the remainder to seconds and multiply by solar longitude, divide by 30, reduce by rate, and add or subtract from the first north-south difference.

sentences.zh: 求合朔時差 以第一第二兩時差相減，乘太陽度分，以三十除之，依率帳之，用加減第一時差，爲合朔時差。

translations.literal: Derive time difference at conjunction—Subtract first and second time differences; multiply by solar degrees; divide by thirty; collect by rate; add or subtract to first time difference—for conjunction time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive time difference at conjunction: subtract the two time differences, multiply by solar longitude, divide by 30, reduce by rate, and add or subtract from the first time difference.

sentences.zh: 求合朔時本輪行度 以本輪日行度一十三度四分通分，以乘食甚凡時，亦通分。

translations.literal: Derive deferent motion at conjunction—Set deferent daily motion thirteen degrees four minutes unified; multiply by greatest-eclipse general time also unified.
translations.idiomatic: Derive deferent motion at conjunction: set deferent daily motion at 13°4′ (unified) and multiply by greatest-eclipse general time, also unified.

sentences.zh: 以二十四除之爲秒，依率收之爲分、爲度，以加減午正本輪行度，午前減，午後加。

translations.literal: Divide by twenty-four for seconds; collect by rate into minutes and degrees; add or subtract to noon-standard deferent motion—before noon subtract, after noon add.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 24 for seconds, reduce by rate to minutes and degrees, and add or subtract from noon deferent motion—subtract before noon, add after.

sentences.zh: 爲合朔時行度。

translations.literal: For deferent motion at conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: The result is deferent motion at conjunction.

sentences.zh: 求比敷分 以本輪行度入立成，太陽、太陰時行影徑分立成。

translations.literal: Derive proportional factor—Enter deferent motion into ready reckoner, solar and lunar hourly motion shadow-radius ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the proportional factor: enter deferent motion into the solar-lunar hourly motion and shadow-radius ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 取同宮近度太陰比敷分，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: Take same-mansion nearby-degree lunar proportional factor; derive by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: Take the lunar proportional factor for the same mansion and nearby degree and apply the proportional method.

sentences.zh: 求東西定差 置合朔時東西差通秒，以比敷分通秒乘之爲纖以六十收之爲微、爲秒、爲分，以加合朔東西差，有加、無減。

translations.literal: Derive east-west fixed difference—Set conjunction east-west difference unified to seconds; multiply by proportional factor unified to seconds for filaments; collect by sixty into micro, seconds, minutes; add to conjunction east-west difference—only add, never subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the east-west fixed difference: convert conjunction east-west difference and proportional factor to seconds, multiply for filaments, reduce by 60, and add to the conjunction east-west difference—always add, never subtract.

sentences.zh: 爲定差。

translations.literal: This is fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 求南北定差 法同東西定差。

translations.literal: Derive north-south fixed difference—Method same as east-west fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the north-south fixed difference by the same method as the east-west fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 求食甚定時即食甚定分。

translations.literal: Derive greatest-eclipse fixed time—which is greatest-eclipse fixed minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Derive greatest-eclipse fixed time, that is, the fixed minutes of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 視其日合朔時，太陽度在立成經緯時加減立成左七宮，其時差，黑字減，白字加，在右七宮，白字減，黑字加，皆加減於子正至合朔時，得數命起正減之，得某時初正。

translations.literal: Inspect that day's conjunction-time solar degree in left seven mansions of ready reckoner—time difference: black characters subtract, white add; in right seven mansions white subtract black add—all add or subtract to midnight-to-conjunction time; obtain number and name from midnight standard subtract—for such-and-such watch initial standard.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect conjunction solar longitude in the ready reckoner: in the left seven mansions subtract black entries and add white for the time difference; in the right seven mansions reverse the signs; add or subtract from midnight-to-conjunction time, name from midnight, and subtract to obtain the watch's initial standard.

sentences.zh: 餘通爲秒，以一千乘之，以一百四下四除之，六十分爲一時，每日一千四百四十分，故以千乘之，又以一四四除之。

translations.literal: Remainder unify to seconds; multiply by one thousand; divide by 144; sixty minutes make one hour; daily 1440 minutes hence multiply by thousand and divide by 144.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the remainder to seconds, multiply by 1,000, and divide by 144—since 60 minutes make one hour and the day has 1,440 minutes.

sentences.zh: 以六十約之，滿百爲刻，即食甚定時。

translations.literal: Reduce by sixty; when full one hundred make one ke—then greatest-eclipse fixed time.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce by 60; at 100 parts make one ke—the result is greatest-eclipse fixed time.

sentences.zh: 求食甚太陰經度 於合朔太陽經度內，加減東西定差，即得食甚太陰經度。

translations.literal: Derive greatest-eclipse lunar longitude—Within conjunction solar longitude add or subtract east-west fixed difference—to obtain greatest-eclipse lunar longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Derive greatest-eclipse lunar longitude: add or subtract the east-west fixed difference from conjunction solar longitude.

sentences.zh: 其加減視食甚定時時差加減。

translations.literal: The add or subtract follows greatest-eclipse fixed time's time-difference add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract according to the sign of the time difference at greatest-eclipse fixed time.

sentences.zh: 求合朔計都度 置食甚凡時通分，以計都日行度三分一十一秒通秒乘之，以二十四除之爲微，滿六十收之爲秒、爲分，以加減其日午時計都行度，羅計逆行，午前合朔加，午後減。

translations.literal: Derive conjunction Rahu/Ketu degree—Set greatest-eclipse general time unified to minutes; multiply by Ketu daily motion three degrees eleven seconds unified; divide by twenty-four for micro; collect by sixty into seconds and minutes; add or subtract to that day's noon Ketu motion—Rahu and Ketu retrograde: before-noon conjunction add, after-noon subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Derive conjunction Ketu longitude: convert greatest-eclipse general time to minutes, multiply by Ketu's daily motion of 3°11″, divide by 24, reduce by 60, and add or subtract from noon Ketu motion—Rahu and Ketu are retrograde: add before noon, subtract after.

sentences.zh: 爲合朔時計都度。

translations.literal: This is Ketu's degree at conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: The result is Ketu's longitude at conjunction.

sentences.zh: 求合朔太陰緯度 食甚時，太降經度內加減合朔時計都度，餘爲計都與月相離度，入太陰緯度立成取之。

translations.literal: Derive the Moon's latitude at conjunction: at greatest eclipse, within the lunar longitude add or subtract Ketu's degree at conjunction; the remainder is Ketu's separation from the Moon; enter the lunar-latitude ready reckoner and take the value.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon's latitude at conjunction: at greatest eclipse, add or subtract Ketu's longitude at conjunction within the lunar longitude; the remainder is Ketu's separation from the Moon; look it up in the lunar-latitude ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 求食甚太陰緯度 南北定差內。

translations.literal: Derive greatest-eclipse lunar latitude: within the north-south fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the greatest-eclipse lunar latitude: apply the north–south fixed parallax.

sentences.zh: 加減合朔時太陰緯度，在黃道南加，北減。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the lunar latitude at conjunction; south of the ecliptic add, north subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the lunar latitude at conjunction: add if south of the ecliptic, subtract if north.

sentences.zh: 得食甚緯度。

translations.literal: Obtain greatest-eclipse latitude.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the greatest-eclipse latitude.

sentences.zh: 求合朔時太陽自行度 用太陽日行度五十九分八秒通秒，以乘食甚凡時，亦通分。

translations.literal: Derive the Sun's proper-motion degree at conjunction: communicate the Sun's daily motion of 59 parts 8 seconds to seconds; multiply by the greatest-eclipse general time, also communicating parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Sun's proper-motion degree at conjunction: convert the Sun's daily motion of 59 parts 8 seconds to seconds, multiply by the greatest-eclipse general time (parts likewise converted to seconds).

sentences.zh: 用二十四除之，得數爲微，滿六十收之爲秒、爲分，以加減其日午正自行度，午前合朔減，午後加。

translations.literal: Divide by twenty-four; the quotient is fine parts; when full sixty, collect as seconds and parts; add or subtract to the day's noon proper-motion degree—pre-noon conjunction subtract, post-noon add.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 24; collect fine parts by sixties into seconds and parts; add or subtract from the day's noon proper-motion degree—subtract before noon, add after noon at conjunction.

sentences.zh: 得合朔自行度。

translations.literal: Obtain the conjunction proper-motion degree.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the Sun's proper-motion degree at conjunction.

sentences.zh: 求太陽徑分 以合朔太陽自行度爲引數，入立成影徑分立成內同宮近度，取太陽徑分，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: Derive the Sun's diameter parts: take the Sun's proper-motion degree at conjunction as the argument; enter the shadow-and-diameter ready reckoner at the same palace and nearest degree; take the solar diameter parts and obtain them by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Sun's diameter parts: set the Sun's proper-motion degree at conjunction as the argument, enter the shadow-and-diameter ready reckoner at the same palace and nearest degree, and obtain the solar diameter parts by proportional interpolation.

sentences.zh: 求太陰徑分 以合朔時本輪行度爲引數，入立成同上內取同宮近度太陰徑分，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: Derive the Moon's diameter parts: take the epicycle motion degree at conjunction as the argument; enter the ready reckoner as above at the same palace and nearest degree for the lunar diameter parts; obtain by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon's diameter parts: set the epicycle motion degree at conjunction as the argument, enter the same ready reckoner at the same palace and nearest degree, and obtain the lunar diameter parts by proportional interpolation.

sentences.zh: 求二半徑分 並太陽、太陰雨徑分，半之。

translations.literal: Derive the two semi-diameter parts: combine the Sun's and Moon's diameter parts and halve.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the two semi-diameter parts: add the solar and lunar diameter parts and halve the sum.

sentences.zh: 求太陽食限分 置二半徑分，內減食甚太陰緯度，餘爲太陽食限。

translations.literal: Derive the solar eclipse limit parts: set the two semi-diameter parts; subtract within the greatest-eclipse lunar latitude; the remainder is the solar eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the solar eclipse limit: set the two semi-diameter parts and subtract the greatest-eclipse lunar latitude; the remainder is the solar eclipse limit.

sentences.zh: 如不及減者不食。

translations.literal: If subtraction is insufficient, there is no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 如太陰無緯度者，食既。

translations.literal: If the Moon has no latitude, the eclipse is total.
translations.idiomatic: If the Moon has no latitude, the eclipse is total.

sentences.zh: 如太陰無緯度而日徑大於月徑者，食有金環。

translations.literal: If the Moon has no latitude and the solar diameter exceeds the lunar diameter, the eclipse has a golden ring.
translations.idiomatic: If the Moon has no latitude and the solar diameter exceeds the lunar diameter, the eclipse is annular.

sentences.zh: 求太陽食甚定分 以太陽食限分通秒，以一千乘之爲實，以太陽徑分通秒爲法除之，以百約之爲分，爲太陽食甚定分。

translations.literal: Derive the solar greatest-eclipse fixed parts: communicate the solar eclipse limit parts to seconds; multiply by one thousand for the dividend; communicate the solar diameter parts to seconds as the divisor and divide; reduce by one hundred to parts—this is the solar greatest-eclipse fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the solar greatest-eclipse fixed parts: convert the solar eclipse limit to seconds, multiply by 1000 as the dividend, divide by the solar diameter in seconds, and scale by 100 to obtain the solar greatest-eclipse fixed parts.

sentences.zh: 求時差即定用分。

translations.literal: Derive the hour equation—namely the fixed usable parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the hour equation, namely the fixed usable parts.

sentences.zh: 食甚太陰緯度通秒自乘，二半徑分亦通秒自乘，兩自乘數相減，餘以平方開之，以二十四乘之爲實，以其日太陰日行度內減太陽日行度通分爲法。

translations.literal: Square the greatest-eclipse lunar latitude in communicated seconds; likewise square the two semi-diameter parts in communicated seconds; subtract the two squares; open the square root of the remainder; multiply by twenty-four for the dividend; set that day's lunar daily motion minus solar daily motion in communicated parts as the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Square the greatest-eclipse lunar latitude in seconds, square the two semi-diameter parts in seconds, subtract the squares, take the square root of the remainder, multiply by 24 for the dividend, and set that day's lunar daily motion minus solar daily motion (in seconds) as the divisor.

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，得數爲分，滿六十分爲一時，爲時差。

translations.literal: Divide the dividend by the divisor to unity; the number is parts; when full sixty parts make one hour—this is the hour equation.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the dividend by the divisor; the quotient is parts, and 60 parts make one hour—this is the hour equation.

sentences.zh: 求初虧 置食甚定時，內減時差，餘時命起子正減之，得初正時。

translations.literal: Derive first contact: set the greatest-eclipse fixed time; subtract within the hour equation; for the remaining hours count from zi noon and subtract—obtain the initial proper hour.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive first contact: set the greatest-eclipse fixed time, subtract the hour equation, count the remainder forward from midnight (zi), and obtain the initial proper hour.

sentences.zh: 餘分通秒，以一千乘之，以一百四十四除之，以六十約之，滿百爲刻，爲初虧時刻。

translations.literal: Communicate the remaining parts to seconds; multiply by one thousand; divide by one hundred forty-four; reduce by sixty; when full one hundred make one ke—this is the first-contact ke mark.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the fractional remainder to seconds, multiply by 1000, divide by 144, reduce by 60, and when the quotient reaches 100 parts form one quarter-hour mark—this is the first-contact quarter-hour.

sentences.zh: 求復圓 置食甚定時，內加時差，命起子正，如初虧法，得復圓時刻。

translations.literal: Derive restoration of roundness: set the greatest-eclipse fixed time; add within the hour equation; count from zi noon as for first contact—obtain the restoration ke mark.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive last contact: set the greatest-eclipse fixed time, add the hour equation, and apply the same counting from midnight as for first contact to obtain the restoration quarter-hour.

sentences.zh: 求初虧食甚圓方位與《大統》法同。

translations.literal: Derive the directions of first contact, greatest eclipse, and restoration—the method is the same as the Grand Concordance procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the azimuths of first contact, greatest eclipse, and last contact: same method as the Grand Concordance calendar.

sentences.zh: 推月食法月食諸數，午前望，用前一日推，午後望，用次一日推。

translations.literal: Procedure for lunar eclipse: lunar-eclipse quantities—for pre-noon full moon use the prior day's reckoning; for post-noon full moon use the next day's reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for lunar eclipse: for a pre-noon full moon reckon from the prior day; for a post-noon full moon reckon from the next day.

sentences.zh: 辨月食限 視望日太陰經度與羅喉或計都度相離二十三度之內，太陽緯度在一度八分之下，爲有食。

translations.literal: Discern the lunar-eclipse limit: inspect whether on the full-moon day the lunar longitude is within twenty-three degrees of Rahu or Ketu, and solar latitude is below one degree eight parts—then there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Discern the lunar-eclipse limit: if on the full-moon day the lunar longitude lies within 23° of Rahu or Ketu and the solar latitude is below 1°8′, an eclipse is possible.

sentences.zh: 又視合望在太陰未出二量，未入二時，其限有帶食。

translations.literal: Also inspect: if the syzygy falls within two du before lunar rise or two hours before setting, the limit carries horizon-eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Also: if syzygy falls within two du before the Moon rises or within two hours before it sets, the eclipse may be visible only at the horizon.

sentences.zh: 其在二時已上者不算。

translations.literal: If two hours or more, do not reckon.
translations.idiomatic: If the interval is two hours or more, do not reckon it.

sentences.zh: 求食甚凡時即經望。

translations.literal: Derive the greatest-eclipse general time—namely mean full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the greatest-eclipse general time, namely the mean full moon.

sentences.zh: 置其日太陰經度內減六宮，如不及減，加十二宮減以減其日午正太陽度爲午前望。

translations.literal: Set that day's lunar longitude; subtract within six palaces; if insufficient to subtract, add twelve palaces and subtract to subtract that day's noon solar degree—for pre-noon full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Set the day's lunar longitude and subtract six palaces; if subtraction fails, add twelve palaces and subtract the day's noon solar longitude—this identifies a pre-noon full moon.

sentences.zh: 如太陽度不及減，加入六宮減之，爲午後望。

translations.literal: If the solar degree is insufficient to subtract, add within six palaces and subtract—for post-noon full moon.
translations.idiomatic: If the solar longitude cannot be subtracted, add six palaces and subtract again—this identifies a post-noon full moon.

sentences.zh: 置相減餘數相通秒，以二十四乘之爲實，置其日太陰經度，內減前一日太陰經度，若在午後望者，減後一日太陽度。

translations.literal: Set the subtraction remainder and communicate to seconds; multiply by twenty-four for the dividend; set that day's lunar longitude and subtract within the prior day's lunar longitude—for post-noon full moon subtract the next day's solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the subtraction remainder to seconds and multiply by 24 for the dividend; set the day's lunar longitude and subtract the prior day's lunar longitude—for a post-noon full moon subtract the next day's solar longitude instead.

sentences.zh: 餘爲太陽日行度。

translations.literal: The remainder is the solar daily motion.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the solar daily motion.

sentences.zh: 兩日行度相減，餘通秒爲法，除實得數爲時。

translations.literal: Subtract the two daily motions; communicate the remainder to seconds as the divisor; divide the dividend to obtain the number of hours.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the two daily motions, convert the remainder to seconds as the divisor, and divide the dividend to obtain hours.

sentences.zh: 其時下餘數，以六十通之爲分、秒，即所求食甚凡時。

translations.literal: For the fractional remainder below the hour, communicate by sixty for parts and seconds—this is the sought greatest-eclipse general time.
translations.idiomatic: For the fractional remainder under the hour, convert by 60 into parts and seconds—this is the greatest-eclipse general time sought.

sentences.zh: 求食甚月離黃道宮度 置食甚凡時，與太陽日行度俱通秒相乘，以二十四除之，得數爲纖潢六十收之爲微、爲秒、爲分，以加減其日午正太陽度，午前望減，午後望加。

translations.literal: Derive the greatest-eclipse Moon's departure from the ecliptic palace: set the greatest-eclipse general time and the solar daily motion, both communicated to seconds and multiplied; divide by twenty-four; the quotient is fine parts—collect by sixty as micro, seconds, and parts; add or subtract to that day's noon solar degree—pre-noon full moon subtract, post-noon add.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon's ecliptic palace at greatest eclipse: multiply the greatest-eclipse general time and solar daily motion (both in seconds), divide by 24, collect fine parts into micro-units, seconds, and parts, and add or subtract from the day's noon solar longitude—subtract before noon, add after noon at full moon.

sentences.zh: 爲望時太陽度，加六宮，即得所求。

translations.literal: This is the solar degree at full moon; add six palaces—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the solar longitude at full moon; add six palaces to obtain the value sought.

sentences.zh: 求晝夜加減差 以望時太陽宮度爲引數，入晝夜加減立成內，取加減分，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: Derive the day-night additive-subtractive difference: take the solar palace at full moon as the argument; enter the day-night additive-subtractive ready reckoner; take the additive-subtractive parts and obtain by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the day–night equation: set the solar palace at full moon as the argument, enter the day–night additive–subtractive ready reckoner, and obtain the correction by proportional interpolation.

sentences.zh: 求食甚定時 置食甚凡時，以晝夜加減差法加減之。

translations.literal: Derive the greatest-eclipse fixed time: set the greatest-eclipse general time; add or subtract by the day-night additive-subtractive method.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the greatest-eclipse fixed time: set the greatest-eclipse general time and apply the day–night equation.

sentences.zh: 午前望減，午後望加。

translations.literal: Pre-noon full moon subtract; post-noon full moon add.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract before noon at full moon; add after noon.

sentences.zh: 得數，用加減一十二時，如午後望加十二時，午前望與十二時相減。

translations.literal: Obtain the number; add or subtract twelve hours—for post-noon full moon add twelve hours; for pre-noon full moon subtract from twelve hours.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the result to twelve hours: for a post-noon full moon add 12 hours; for a pre-noon full moon subtract from 12 hours.

sentences.zh: 命起子正，得初正時。

translations.literal: Count from zi noon; obtain the initial proper hour.
translations.idiomatic: Count from midnight (zi); obtain the initial proper hour.

sentences.zh: 其小餘，如法收爲刻，法詳日食。

translations.literal: For the small remainder, collect by the method into ke marks—the method is detailed under solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: For the fractional remainder, collect quarter-hour marks by the same method as for solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 得定時。

translations.literal: Obtain the fixed time.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the fixed time.

sentences.zh: 求望時計都度 置食甚凡時，通秒爲實，以計都日行度三分一十一秒通秒乘之，以二十四除之，得數爲纖以六十收之爲微、爲秒、爲分，用加減其日午正計都行度，羅計逆行，午前望加，午後望減。

translations.literal: Derive Ketu's degree at full moon: set the greatest-eclipse general time communicated to seconds as the dividend; multiply by Ketu's daily motion of 3 parts 11 seconds communicated to seconds; divide by twenty-four; the quotient is fine parts—collect by sixty as micro, seconds, and parts; add or subtract to that day's noon Ketu motion degree—Rahu and Ketu retrograde: pre-noon full moon add, post-noon subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive Ketu's longitude at full moon: convert the greatest-eclipse general time to seconds as the dividend, multiply by Ketu's daily motion of 3 parts 11 seconds, divide by 24, collect fine parts into micro-units, seconds, and parts, and add or subtract from the day's noon Ketu longitude—Rahu and Ketu are retrograde: add before noon, subtract after noon at full moon.

sentences.zh: 即得。

translations.literal: Then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The result is obtained.

sentences.zh: 求望時太陰緯度 置食甚月離黃道度，內減望時計都度，如不及減，加十二宮減。

translations.literal: Derive the lunar latitude at full moon: set the Moon's departure from the ecliptic at full moon; subtract within Ketu's degree at full moon; if insufficient to subtract, add twelve palaces and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the lunar latitude at full moon: set the Moon's ecliptic longitude at full moon and subtract Ketu's longitude at full moon; if subtraction fails, add twelve palaces and subtract again.

sentences.zh: 餘爲計都與月相離度，入太陰緯度立成取之。

translations.literal: The remainder is Ketu's separation from the Moon; enter the lunar-latitude ready reckoner and take the value.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is Ketu's separation from the Moon; look it up in the lunar-latitude ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 求望時本輪行度即入遲疾歷。

translations.literal: Derive the epicycle motion degree at full moon—namely entry into the slow-fast sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the epicycle motion degree at full moon, namely entry into the slow–fast sequence.

sentences.zh: 置太陰本輪日行度，十三四分。

translations.literal: Set the Moon's epicycle daily motion at thirteen parts four.
translations.idiomatic: Set the Moon's epicycle daily motion at 13 parts 4.

sentences.zh: 通分，以食甚凡時通秒乘之，以二十四除之爲微，以六十收之爲秒、爲分、爲度，用加減其日午正本輪行度，午前望減，午後加。

translations.literal: Communicate parts; multiply by the greatest-eclipse general time communicated to seconds; divide by twenty-four for fine parts; collect by sixty as seconds, parts, and degrees; add or subtract to that day's noon epicycle motion degree—pre-noon full moon subtract, post-noon add.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to a common denominator, multiply by the greatest-eclipse general time in seconds, divide by 24 for fine parts, collect by sixties into seconds, parts, and degrees, and add or subtract from the day's noon epicycle motion—subtract before noon, add after noon at full moon.

sentences.zh: 即得。

translations.literal: Then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The result is obtained.

sentences.zh: 求太陰徑分 以望時本輪行宮度，入影徑分立成求之。

translations.literal: Derive the lunar diameter parts: take the epicycle palace degree at full moon; enter the shadow-and-diameter ready reckoner and obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the lunar diameter parts: set the epicycle palace degree at full moon and obtain the value from the shadow-and-diameter ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 法詳日食。

translations.literal: The method is detailed under solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: The method is the same as for solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求太陰影徑分 以望時本輪行宮度，放影徑分立成，取之。

translations.literal: Derive the lunar shadow diameter parts: take the epicycle palace degree at full moon; enter the shadow-diameter ready reckoner and take the value.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the lunar shadow diameter parts: set the epicycle palace degree at full moon and take the value from the shadow-diameter ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 求望時太陽自行度 以太陽日行度五十九分八秒與食甚凡時俱通秒相乘，以二十四除之，得數爲纖，滿六十收爲微、爲秒、爲分，以減其日午正太陽自行度。

translations.literal: Derive the Sun's proper-motion degree at full moon: communicate the solar daily motion of 59 parts 8 seconds and the greatest-eclipse general time to seconds and multiply; divide by twenty-four; the quotient is fine parts—when full sixty collect as micro, seconds, and parts; subtract from that day's noon solar proper-motion degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Sun's proper-motion degree at full moon: convert the solar daily motion of 59 parts 8 seconds and the greatest-eclipse general time to seconds, multiply, divide by 24, collect fine parts into micro-units, seconds, and parts, and subtract from the day's noon solar proper-motion degree.

sentences.zh: 法同日食求太陽經度。

translations.literal: The method is the same as for solar eclipse in deriving solar longitude.
translations.idiomatic: The method matches solar-eclipse procedure for deriving solar longitude.

sentences.zh: 求影徑減差 以其日太陽自行範度爲引數，入影徑立成內，於同宮近度取太陰影徑差分，依比例法求之。

translations.literal: Derive the shadow-diameter reduction difference: take that day's solar proper-motion palace degree as the argument; enter the shadow-diameter ready reckoner; at the same palace and nearest degree take the lunar shadow-diameter difference parts; obtain by proportional method.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the shadow-diameter reduction: set that day's solar proper-motion palace as the argument, enter the shadow-diameter ready reckoner, take the lunar shadow-diameter difference at the same palace and nearest degree, and obtain it by proportional interpolation.

sentences.zh: 法詳前。

translations.literal: The method is detailed previously.
translations.idiomatic: The method is as given above.

sentences.zh: 求影徑定分 置太陰影徑分，內減影徑減差分。

translations.literal: Derive the fixed shadow-diameter parts: set the lunar shadow-diameter parts; subtract within the shadow-diameter reduction difference parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the fixed shadow-diameter parts: set the lunar shadow-diameter parts and subtract the shadow-diameter reduction.

sentences.zh: 求二半徑分 置太陰徑分，加影徑定分，半之。

translations.literal: Derive the two semi-diameter parts: set the lunar diameter parts; add the fixed shadow-diameter parts; halve.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the two semi-diameter parts: add the lunar diameter parts and the fixed shadow-diameter parts, then halve the sum.

sentences.zh: 求太陰食限 置二半徑分，內減望時太陰緯度。

translations.literal: Derive the lunar eclipse limit: set the two semi-diameter parts; subtract within the lunar latitude at full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the lunar eclipse limit: set the two semi-diameter parts and subtract the lunar latitude at full moon.

sentences.zh: 求食甚定分 置食限分，通秒，以一千乘之爲實，以太陰徑分秒爲法，除之，以百約之災分，爲食甚定分。

translations.literal: Derive the greatest-eclipse fixed parts: set the eclipse-limit parts communicated to seconds; multiply by one thousand for the dividend; use the lunar diameter in seconds as the divisor and divide; reduce by one hundred to parts—this is the greatest-eclipse fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the greatest-eclipse fixed parts: convert the eclipse limit to seconds, multiply by 1000 as the dividend, divide by the lunar diameter in seconds, scale by 100 to parts, and obtain the greatest-eclipse fixed parts.

sentences.zh: 求太陰逐時行過太陽分 置太陰望時經度，減前一日太陰經度，又置望時太陽自行度，減前一日太陽自行度，以兩餘數相減，爲太陰晝夜行過太陽度。

translations.literal: Derive the Moon's hourly motion past the Sun: set the lunar longitude at full moon and subtract the prior day's lunar longitude; also set the solar proper-motion degree at full moon and subtract the prior day's solar proper-motion degree; subtract the two remainders—this is the Moon's day-night motion past the Sun.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon's hourly motion relative to the Sun: subtract the prior day's lunar longitude from the full-moon lunar longitude, and the prior day's solar proper motion from the full-moon solar proper motion; subtract the two remainders to obtain the Moon's diurnal motion past the Sun.

sentences.zh: 通秒以二十四除之，滿六十收之，得逐時行過太陽分。

translations.literal: Communicate to seconds and divide by twenty-four; collect by sixty—obtain the hourly motion past the Sun in parts.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to seconds, divide by 24, and collect by sixties to obtain the hourly motion past the Sun in parts.

sentences.zh: 求時差 以太陰緯度分，通秒自乘，又以二半徑分通秒自乘，兩數相減，餘開平方爲實，以太陰行過太陽度通秒爲法除之，得數即時刻差。

translations.literal: Derive the hour equation: square the lunar latitude parts communicated to seconds; likewise square the two semi-diameter parts communicated to seconds; subtract the two numbers; open the square root of the remainder for the dividend; communicate the Moon's motion past the Sun to seconds as the divisor and divide—the number is the hour-and-ke difference.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the hour equation: square the lunar latitude in seconds and the two semi-diameter parts in seconds, subtract, take the square root as the dividend, divide by the Moon's hourly motion past the Sun in seconds, and obtain the hour-and-mark difference.

sentences.zh: 即初虧至食甚定用分。

translations.literal: This is the fixed usable parts from first contact to greatest eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fixed usable interval from first contact to greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求初虧復圓時刻 以時差減食甚定時，得初虧時刻。

translations.literal: Derive the ke marks of first contact and restoration: subtract the hour equation from the greatest-eclipse fixed time—obtain the first-contact ke mark.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the quarter-hours of first contact and last contact: subtract the hour equation from the greatest-eclipse fixed time to obtain first contact.

sentences.zh: 加食甚定時，得復圓時刻。

translations.literal: Add to the greatest-eclipse fixed time—obtain the restoration ke mark.
translations.idiomatic: Add the hour equation to the greatest-eclipse fixed time to obtain last contact.

sentences.zh: 其命時收刻之法，並同日食。

translations.literal: The methods for counting hours and collecting ke marks are both the same as for solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: The methods for counting hours and collecting quarter-hour marks are the same as for solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求食既至食甚時差 置二半徑分，減太陰徑分，通秒自乘，又置太陰緯度亦通秒自乘，相減，平方開之爲實。

translations.literal: Derive the hour equation from totality to greatest eclipse: set the two semi-diameter parts; subtract the lunar diameter parts; square in communicated seconds; also set the lunar latitude and square in communicated seconds; subtract; open the square root for the dividend.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the hour equation from totality to greatest eclipse: subtract the lunar diameter from the two semi-diameter parts, square in seconds, square the lunar latitude in seconds, subtract, and take the square root as the dividend.

sentences.zh: 以太陰逐時行過太陽度通秒爲法除之，得數即時差。

translations.literal: Communicate the Moon's hourly motion past the Sun to seconds as the divisor and divide—the number is the hour equation.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the Moon's hourly motion past the Sun in seconds; the quotient is the hour equation.

sentences.zh: 求食既生光時刻 以食既至食甚時差，減食甚定時，爲食既時刻。

translations.literal: Derive the ke marks of totality and emergence of light: subtract the totality-to-greatest-eclipse hour equation from the greatest-eclipse fixed time—this is the totality ke mark.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the quarter-hours of totality and emergence of light: subtract the totality-to-greatest-eclipse hour equation from the greatest-eclipse fixed time to obtain totality.

sentences.zh: 加食甚定時，爲生光時刻。

translations.literal: Add to the greatest-eclipse fixed time—this is the emergence-of-light ke mark.
translations.idiomatic: Add the hour equation to the greatest-eclipse fixed time to obtain emergence of light.

sentences.zh: 求初虧食甚復圓方位 與《大統》法同。

translations.literal: Derive the directions of first contact, greatest eclipse, and restoration—the method is the same as the Grand Concordance procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the azimuths of first contact, greatest eclipse, and last contact: same method as the Grand Concordance calendar.

sentences.zh: 求日出入時 以午正太陽經度爲引數，入西域晝夜時立成，取其度分，依比例法求之，爲未定分。

translations.literal: Derive the times of sunrise and sunset: take the noon solar longitude as the argument; enter the Western Regions day-night-time ready reckoner; take the degree parts and obtain by proportional method as the first unfixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive sunrise and sunset times: set noon solar longitude as the argument, enter the Western Regions day–night-time ready reckoner, and obtain degree parts by proportional interpolation as the first provisional value.

sentences.zh: 又引於數相對宮度內，取其度分，如初宮三度，向六宮三度取之。

translations.literal: Also take the argument in the opposing palace degree within the reckoner; take the degree parts—for example, in the first palace three degrees, take three degrees toward the sixth palace.
translations.idiomatic: Also take the opposing palace in the reckoner—for example, 3° in the first palace paired with 3° toward the sixth palace—and obtain degree parts the same way.

sentences.zh: 亦依比例法求之，爲後未定分。

translations.literal: Again obtain by proportional method as the second unfixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Obtain a second provisional value by proportional interpolation.

sentences.zh: 兩未定分相減，不及減，加三百六十度減。

translations.literal: Subtract the two unfixed parts; if insufficient to subtract, add three hundred sixty degrees and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the two provisional values; if subtraction fails, add 360° and subtract again.

sentences.zh: 餘通秒，用十五除之，六十收之爲分、爲時，得其日晝時分秒。

translations.literal: Communicate the remainder to seconds; divide by fifteen; collect by sixty as parts and hours—obtain that day's daytime in hours, parts, and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the remainder to seconds, divide by 15, collect by sixties into parts and hours, and obtain that day's daylight in hours, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 半之爲其日半晝時分秒。

translations.literal: Halve for that day's half-daylight in hours, parts, and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Halve to obtain half the daylight for that day in hours, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 以半晝時分秒減十二時，餘爲日出時分秒，加十二時爲日入時分秒。

translations.literal: Subtract the half-daylight from twelve hours—the remainder is sunrise in hours, parts, and seconds; add twelve hours for sunset in hours, parts, and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract half-daylight from 12 hours for sunrise; add 12 hours for sunset.

sentences.zh: 求日月出入帶食分秒 視其日日出時分秒，較多於初虧時分秒，少於食甚定時及復時分秒者，即有帶食。

translations.literal: Derive the parts and seconds of Sun-Moon ingress with eclipse: inspect whether that day's sunrise in hours, parts, and seconds is greater than first-contact hours, parts, and seconds yet less than greatest-eclipse fixed time and restoration hours, parts, and seconds—then there is horizon-eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive horizon-eclipse parts and seconds: if sunrise falls after first contact but before greatest eclipse and last contact, the eclipse is visible only at sunrise (horizon eclipse).

sentences.zh: 置其日日出時或日入時，與食甚定時分秒相減，餘爲帶食差。

translations.literal: Set that day's sunrise or sunset time and subtract the greatest-eclipse fixed time in hours, parts, and seconds—the remainder is the horizon-eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the greatest-eclipse fixed time from that day's sunrise or sunset time; the remainder is the horizon-eclipse offset.

sentences.zh: 置日月食甚定分，以帶食差通秒乘之，以時差通秒除之，得數爲帶食分。

translations.literal: Set the Sun-Moon greatest-eclipse fixed parts; multiply by the horizon-eclipse difference communicated to seconds; divide by the hour equation communicated to seconds—the number is the horizon-eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar or lunar greatest-eclipse fixed parts, multiply by the horizon-eclipse offset in seconds, divide by the hour equation in seconds, and obtain the horizon-eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 於食甚定分內減帶食分，餘爲日月帶食所見之分。

translations.literal: Subtract the horizon-eclipse parts within the greatest-eclipse fixed parts—the remainder is the parts of the Sun-Moon horizon eclipse actually seen.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the horizon-eclipse parts from the greatest-eclipse fixed parts; the remainder is the magnitude visible at the horizon.

sentences.zh: 求月食更點 置二十四時，內減晝時，又減晨昏時，七十二分，即中歷之五刻弱也。

translations.literal: Derive the lunar-eclipse watches and marks: set twenty-four hours; subtract within daytime; again subtract morning-evening time of seventy-two parts—this is the Central Calendar's five ke and a fraction weak.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive lunar-eclipse watches and marks: set 24 hours, subtract daylight, then subtract morning-and-evening time of 72 parts—this is the Central Calendar's 5 quarter-hours less a fraction.

sentences.zh: 餘不夜時，通秒五約之爲更法。

translations.literal: For the remaining night time, communicate to seconds and reduce by five for the watch divisor.
translations.idiomatic: For the remaining night hours, convert to seconds and divide by 5 to obtain the watch divisor.

sentences.zh: 寺分更法爲點法。

translations.literal: Divide parts by the watch divisor for the mark divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the fractional parts by the watch divisor to obtain the mark divisor.

sentences.zh: 如食在子正以前者，置初虧食甚復圓等時，內減日入時，又減半晨昏時，三十六分。

translations.literal: If the eclipse is before zi noon: set the times of first contact, greatest eclipse, restoration, etc.; subtract within sunset time; again subtract half the morning-evening time of thirty-six parts.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse is before midnight: set first contact, greatest eclipse, last contact, and the like, subtract sunset time, then subtract half the morning-and-evening interval of 36 parts.

sentences.zh: 餘通就，以更法減之爲更數。

translations.literal: Communicate the remainder to seconds; subtract by the watch divisor for the watch count.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the remainder to seconds and divide by the watch divisor to obtain the watch count.

sentences.zh: 不滿更法者，以點法減之爲點數。

translations.literal: What does not fill the watch divisor—subtract by the mark divisor for the mark count.
translations.idiomatic: For the remainder less than one watch, divide by the mark divisor to obtain the mark count.

sentences.zh: 食在子正已後者，置夜時半之，加初虧食甚復圓等時，以更法減之爲更數。

translations.literal: If the eclipse is after zi noon: halve the night time; add the times of first contact, greatest eclipse, restoration, etc.; subtract by the watch divisor for the watch count.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse is after midnight: halve the night hours, add first contact, greatest eclipse, last contact, and the like, and divide by the watch divisor for the watch count.

sentences.zh: 不滿更法者，以點法減之爲點數。

translations.literal: What does not fill the watch divisor—subtract by the mark divisor for the mark count.
translations.idiomatic: For the remainder less than one watch, divide by the mark divisor to obtain the mark count.

sentences.zh: 皆命起初更、初點。

translations.literal: In all cases count from the first watch and first mark.
translations.idiomatic: In every case count from the first watch and first mark.

sentences.zh: 更法減之，減一次爲一更，其減餘不滿法者，亦虛命爲一更。

translations.literal: Subtract by the watch divisor; one subtraction counts as one watch; if the subtraction remainder does not fill the divisor, still count nominally as one watch.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract repeatedly by the watch divisor; each subtraction counts as one watch; if the final remainder is less than one divisor, still count it nominally as one watch.

sentences.zh: 點法仿此。

translations.literal: The mark divisor follows this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: The mark divisor follows the same rule.

sentences.zh: ▲太陰五星凌犯

translations.literal: ▲ Lunar and Five-Planets Encroachment
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Lunar and Five-Planets Encroachment

sentences.zh: 求太陰晝夜行度 以本日經度與次日經度相減，餘即本日晝夜行度。

translations.literal: Derive the Moon's day-night motion in degrees: subtract this day's longitude from the next day's longitude—the remainder is this day's day-night motion in degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon's diurnal motion in degrees: subtract this day's longitude from the next day's; the remainder is the day's diurnal motion.

sentences.zh: 求太陰晨昏刻度 置其日午太陰經度，內加立成太陰出入晨昏加減立成其日昏刻加差，即爲其日太陰昏刻經度。

translations.literal: Derive the Moon's morning-evening scale degrees: set that day's noon lunar longitude; add within the ready reckoner for lunar ingress-egress morning-evening additive-subtractive that day's evening-ke additive difference—this is that day's lunar longitude at evening ke.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon's morning-and-evening scale longitudes: set the day's noon lunar longitude, add that day's evening-quarter additive from the lunar ingress–egress morning–evening ready reckoner, and obtain the lunar longitude at evening quarter.

sentences.zh: 置其次日午正太陰經度，減立成其日晨刻減差，即爲其日太陰晨刻經度。

translations.literal: Set the next day's noon lunar longitude; subtract the ready reckoner's that-day morning-ke subtractive difference—this is that day's lunar longitude at morning ke.
translations.idiomatic: Set the next day's noon lunar longitude, subtract that day's morning-quarter subtractive from the ready reckoner, and obtain the lunar longitude at morning quarter.

sentences.zh: 求月出入度 置其日午正太陰經度，加立成內即前立成其日月入加差，即爲其日月入時太陰經度。

translations.literal: Derive the Moon's ingress and egress longitudes: set that day's noon lunar longitude; add within the ready reckoner the prior ready reckoner's Sun–Moon ingress additive correction—this is the lunar longitude at Sun–Moon ingress time.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon's ingress and egress longitudes: set the day's noon lunar longitude, add that day's Sun–Moon ingress correction from the lunar ingress–egress ready reckoner, and obtain the lunar longitude at ingress.

sentences.zh: 加立成內其日月出加差，即其日月出時太陰經度。

translations.literal: Add within the ready reckoner the Sun–Moon egress additive correction—this is the lunar longitude at Sun–Moon egress time.
translations.idiomatic: Add that day's Sun–Moon egress correction from the ready reckoner to obtain the lunar longitude at egress.

sentences.zh: 耱太陰所犯星座 朔後視昏刻度至月入度，望後視月出度至晨刻度，入黃道南北各像星立成內，經緯度相近在一度已下者，取之。

translations.literal: Derive the constellation the Moon encroaches: after new moon, consider from evening-scale longitude to moon-ingress longitude; after full moon, consider from moon-egress longitude to morning-scale longitude; enter the north and south of the ecliptic star-image ready reckoners; where longitude and latitude are within one degree, take it.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the star the Moon encroaches: after new moon, reckon from evening-scale longitude to ingress longitude; after full moon, from egress longitude to morning-scale longitude; look up north and south of the ecliptic in the star-image ready reckoners and select any star whose longitude and latitude lie within 1°.

sentences.zh: 求時刻 置其日午正太陰經度，與取到各像星經度相減，通分，以二十四乘之，以太陰晝夜行度亦通分除之，得初正時。

translations.literal: Derive the time: set that day's noon lunar longitude and subtract the taken star-image longitude; convert to a common denominator, multiply by twenty-four, and divide by the lunar diurnal motion likewise converted—obtain the initial proper hour.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the time: subtract the selected star's longitude from the day's noon lunar longitude, convert to a common denominator, multiply by 24, divide by the lunar diurnal motion (also converted), and obtain the initial proper hour.

sentences.zh: 其小餘，以六十通之爲分，以一竿千乘之，一百國十四除之，以百約之爲刻，即得所求時刻。

translations.literal: For the small remainder, convert by sixty to parts; multiply by one thousand per rod; divide by one hundred forty-four; reduce by one hundred to quarter-hours—obtain the sought time.
translations.idiomatic: For the fractional remainder, convert by 60 into parts, multiply by 1000, divide by 144, scale by 100 into quarter-hours, and obtain the time sought.

sentences.zh: 求上下相離分 置太陰緯度與年犯星緯度相減，餘爲上下相離分。

translations.literal: Derive the upper-and-lower separation parts: set the lunar latitude and the year-encroaching star's latitude and subtract—the remainder is the upper-and-lower separation.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the vertical separation: subtract the encroached star's latitude from the lunar latitude; the remainder is the vertical separation.

sentences.zh: 若月星同在南，月多爲下離。

translations.literal: If Moon and star are both south of the ecliptic, a greater lunar latitude is lower separation.
translations.idiomatic: If the Moon and star are both south of the ecliptic, the greater latitude is lower separation.

sentences.zh: 同在北，月多爲上離，下爲下離。

translations.literal: If both are north, a greater lunar latitude is upper separation; a lesser is lower separation.
translations.idiomatic: If both are north, the greater latitude is upper separation and the lesser is lower separation.

sentences.zh: 若南北不同，月在北爲上離，南爲下離。

translations.literal: If north and south differ, the Moon north of the ecliptic is upper separation; south is lower separation.
translations.idiomatic: If they lie on opposite sides of the ecliptic, a northern Moon is upper separation and a southern Moon is lower separation.

sentences.zh: 求五星凌犯各星相離 置其日五星經緯度，入黃道立成內，視各像內外星經緯度，在一度已下和取之。

translations.literal: Derive the five planets' encroachment separation from each star: set that day's five-planet longitude and latitude; enter the ecliptic ready reckoner; inspect inner and outer star-image longitudes and latitudes—within one degree, take the matching pair.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive each planet's separation from encroached stars: set the day's planetary longitude and latitude, enter the ecliptic ready reckoner, and select any star whose longitude and latitude lie within 1° of the planet's.

sentences.zh: 其五星緯度與各星緯度相減，餘即上下相離分。

translations.literal: Subtract each star's latitude from the five-planet latitude—the remainder is the upper-and-lower separation.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract each star's latitude from the planet's latitude; the remainder is the vertical separation.

sentences.zh: 求月犯五星，五星相犯 視太陰經緯度，五星經緯度相近在一度已下者，取之。

translations.literal: Derive the Moon encroaching the five planets and the five planets encroaching one another: inspect lunar longitude and latitude and five-planet longitude and latitude—where they are within one degree, take it.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon encroaching the five planets and mutual planetary encroachment: compare lunar and planetary longitudes and latitudes and record any pair within 1°.
